items.summary: Original concept summary of McMillan-style options education: map strategy families (covered call, protective put, verticals, calendar/diagonal, straddle/strangle, butterfly) to outlook and volatility regime using public quotes only. Emphasizes IV vs historical volatility and simple risk-shape intuition—not personalized trade advice, and no copyrighted chapter text.

iv_vs_hv_screen ← compare_atm_iv_to_realized_vol when both public
probability_edu ← discuss_chance_in_plain_language without guaranteeing outcomes

items.title: 安德烈·科斯托拉尼 — 市場週期／雞蛋理論（書架：一個投機者的告白等）
items.summary: Public-knowledge cycle framing: firm hands accumulate near despair while shaky hands dominate near euphoria; volume marks ownership transfer; rates often lag risk appetite. Used here as an egg-phase proxy for US and TW dials, not as trade anecdotes.
formulas: egg_proxy ← f(dd_from_252d_high, index_vol_ratio_20, ΔUS10Y_60d)
firm_hands ← (ret_21d < 0) ∧ (vol_ratio_20 ≥ 1.5) ∧ (close > SMA200)
shaky_hands ← elevated_ret_63d ∧ (vol_ratio_20 ≥ 1.8)
K6 reclaim ← prior_shock ∧ (close > SMA20)

items.title: 掌握市場週期
items.summary: Marks-style practice: take the market’s temperature and adjust aggressiveness rather than calling exact tops. Hot markets raise the bar; cold markets allow survivor hunting with tighter risk budgets.
formulas: temperatureScore ∈ [−2, +2] ← Σ proxies(pct_from_SMA200, dd_from_52w_high, ATR_pct_20, ΔUS10Y_20d, breadth, optional HYG/LQD)
hot (temp ≥ +1) → dial ≤ selective, size_mult cap ≈ 0.9×
cold (temp ≤ −1) → allow constructive/aggressive on survivors above SMA200
items.mathGateNote: temperatureScore already coded; checklist completeness + clamp proofs pending math gate.

items.title: 圖解地表最簡單的利率教科書
items.summary: Rates-literacy primer: treat yield direction as a first-class regime input. Fast spikes lean defensive; sustained declines can reopen risk-on if the egg phase is not euphoric. TW uses US10Y plus USD/TWD stress rather than pretending local yields equal US10Y.
formulas: R2: ΔUS10Y_20d ≥ +0.25 pp → dial_cap ≤ selective / defensive bias
R3: ΔUS10Y_60d ≤ −0.25 pp ∧ egg ≠ euphoric → aggressive bias allowed
R4 (TW): ΔUSDTWD_20d stress → contagion overlay
items.mathGateNote: Rate features wired into regime; TW FX overlay still watch-listed for gate proofs.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 利率入門：把殖利率方向當作一級政權輸入。急升偏防守；持續下滑且雞蛋相位非亢奮時可重開風險偏好。台股以美債＋美元／台幣壓力輔助，而非假裝本地利率等於美債。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 利率入门：把收益率方向当作一级政权输入。急升偏防守；持续下滑且鸡蛋相位非亢奋时可重开风险偏好。台股以美债＋美元／台币压力辅助，而非假装本地利率等于美债。
summaryLocalized.ja: 金利リテラシー：利回り方向を第一級のレジーム入力に。急騰は守備寄り；持続下落かつ卵位相が陶酔でなければリスクオン再開可。台湾は米金利＋USD/TWDストレスを使い、現地金利＝米金利と見なさない。

items.title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?
items.summary: Authors propose FINSABER, a longer-horizon / wider-universe backtest for LLM timing strategies. Reported LLM edges shrink under broader cross-sections and multi-decade windows; regime splits show strategies too cautious in bulls and too aggressive in bears. Takeaway for this site: prioritise regime-aware risk controls and trend detection over stacking LLM complexity — aligns with our math-gate rule before adoption.
formulas: evaluate timing_strategy on long_window × large_universe (anti data-snooping)
regime_split: bull → avoid over-conservatism; bear → tighten risk controls
gate: require regime-aware controls before status=adopted
items.mathGateNote: Supports keeping LLM/narrative packs off production until regime-aware gates pass.

items.title: Generative AI for Stock Selection
items.summary: Studies whether generative AI can automate feature discovery in US equities via RAG and structured prompting, then feed features into tabular ML for short-horizon forecasts. AI features are competitive with baselines when retrieval quality is controlled and are weakly correlated with traditional signals (suggesting combination). Site takeaway: interesting research path, but not a drop-in screen — needs reproducible features + math gate.

items.title: ChatGPT in Systematic Investing: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Returns with LLMs
items.summary: Tests whether prompt-engineered ChatGPT scores on firm-specific news can improve a long-only cross-sectional momentum portfolio of S&P 500 stocks. LLM scores condition both selection and weights versus a classic past-return momentum baseline. Authors report higher Sharpe/Sortino in-sample and after the model pre-training cut-off, with gains strongest in concentrated high-conviction books and monthly rebalancing; turnover rises but results are shown net of assumed transaction costs. Site takeaway: news-conditioned momentum is a research candidate only — needs public reproducible news feeds, cost controls, and math-gate verification before any live screen.

llm_score ← ChatGPT(prompt | recent_firm_news) then normalize to weight tilt
enhanced_w ← reweight(baseline_w, llm_score) with turnover and cost checks
gate: keep status=candidate until math gate + public data path exist

items.title: Does Optimistic Investor Sentiment Accelerate Taiwan Stock Market Liquidity?
items.summary: Studies whether bullish retail and institutional sentiment improve Taiwan equity liquidity measured by the Amihud illiquidity index. Finding: optimistic retail sentiment is linked to higher liquidity risk (and can worsen illiquidity for already high-liquidity-risk names), while institutional sentiment effects are insignificant; irrational retail sentiment matters more for TW liquidity than institutional tone. Site takeaway: treat retail-sentiment overlays as a TW microstructure watch item — separate from US screens — and do not promote sentiment chasing into live picks while the math gate is closed.

items.title: The Dynamics of Deposit Flightiness and its Impact on Financial Stability
items.summary: NBER working paper documenting that bank deposit flightiness varies over time and peaked after Covid, often alongside QE and low policy rates. Heterogeneous depositor convenience demand implies that after large deposit inflows the marginal depositor is less convenience-seeking, raising panic-run risk; rate hikes are then more destabilizing when they follow QE. Site takeaway: reinforces Marks/Kostolany-style regime awareness — treat post-QE tightening as a liquidity-stress watch regime for US rate literacy screens, not as an automatic short signal, and keep status candidate while math gate is closed.

regime_flag ← (recent_QE_inflows) ∧ (policy_rate_hiking) → elevate funding_stress_watch
link_to_equity: funding_stress_watch → tighten risk overlays (candidate only)
gate: regime labels educational until olympiad math gate passes

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: NBER 工作論文指出銀行存款「易飛」程度隨時間變化，疫情後偏高，並常與 QE、低政策利率並存。存款人對便利性偏好異質：大量資金流入後，邊際存款人較不重視便利性，擠兌風險上升；若先有 QE 再升息，穩定衝擊更大。本站取捨：強化 Marks／科斯托拉尼式體制意識——把 QE 後緊縮視為美股利率識字的流動性壓力觀察區間，而非自動放空訊號，並在數學閘門關閉期間維持候選。
summaryLocalized.en: NBER working paper documenting that bank deposit flightiness varies over time and peaked after Covid, often alongside QE and low policy rates. Heterogeneous depositor convenience demand implies that after large deposit inflows the marginal depositor is less convenience-seeking, raising panic-run risk; rate hikes are then more destabilizing when they follow QE. Site takeaway: reinforces Marks/Kostolany-style regime awareness — treat post-QE tightening as a liquidity-stress watch regime for US rate literacy screens, not as an automatic short signal, and keep status candidate while math gate is closed.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: NBER 工作论文指出银行存款「易飞」程度随时间变化，疫情后偏高，并常与 QE、低政策利率并存。存款人对便利性偏好异质：大量资金流入后，边际存款人较不重视便利性，挤兑风险上升；若先有 QE 再升息，稳定冲击更大。本站取舍：强化 Marks／科斯托拉尼式体制意识——把 QE 后紧缩视为美股利率识字的流动性压力观察区间，而非自动放空信号，并在数学闸门关闭期间维持候选。
summaryLocalized.ja: NBERワーキングペーパーは、銀行預金の逃げやすさが時間とともに変化し、コロナ後に高まり、QEと低政策金利と並存しやすいと示す。預金者の利便性選好の異質性により、大規模流入後の限界預金者は利便性を相対的に重視せず取り付けリスクが高まり、QE後の利上げはより不安定化しやすい。当サイトの結論：Marks/Kostolany的レジーム意識を強化し、QE後引き締めを米国金利リテラシーの資金ストレス監視区間として扱い、自動ショート信号にはせず、数学ゲート閉鎖中は候補に留める。

items.title: The Performance Comparison Between Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Momentum Strategies in Taiwan Stock Market
items.summary: Compares time-series (TS) versus cross-sectional (CS) momentum on Taiwan equities (1993–2025, 1,169 listed and delisted names). Builds five TS and five CS designs across lookbacks and holdings (80+80 specs) and scores them with excess returns, certainty-equivalent returns, CAPM and Fama–French three-factor alphas. Main result: volatility-scaled momentum beats unscaled, and TS on average outperforms CS; profits are mostly from the long leg, with shorts mattering more in crashes. Site takeaway: prefer volatility-managed TS-style relative strength for TW screens as a research candidate only — keep US/TW markets separate and do not adopt into live math while the olympiad gate is closed.

cs_signal ← rank(past_J_return) within TW universe then long top / short bottom
score ← AER | CER | CAPM_alpha | FF3_alpha over hold_K
gate: TW-only candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.title: Liquidity Premium and Investment Horizons
items.summary: Estimates Kyle (1985) price-impact λ from daily CRSP equity order flow (2020–2025) via within-month regressions and an Amihud-style ratio, then tests cross-sectional return forecasts. Signed order flow predicts contemporaneous and one-month-ahead returns; volume volatility predicts lower subsequent returns. Fama–MacBeth slopes are significant after Newey–West adjustment. Authors frame the illiquidity premium as adverse-selection / temporary mispricing (λ widens when order flow is low, then narrows) rather than pure risk compensation. Site takeaway: signed-flow / Kyle-λ overlays are a US microstructure watch candidate — public OHLC proxies only, not CRSP-locked for live screens — and stay candidate while the math gate is closed.
formulas: signed_flow_day ← volume × sign(Δprice) ; signed_flow_month ← sum(signed_flow_day)
kyle_lambda_reg ← OLS_slope(Δprice on signed_flow_day) within month
kyle_lambda_amihud ← mean(|ret| / dollar_volume) within month
watch: low_signed_flow → wide_lambda → liquidity_stress_flag (US candidate only)

items.title: Retail Trader's Ruin: An Anatomy of Popular Signal Failure
items.summary: Joint falsification test of five widely promoted retail technical families (trend/MA, oscillator/RSI-MACD-Bollinger, candlestick, volume/OBV, calendar/Sell-in-May) plus a liquidity-weighted Jegadeesh–Titman 12-1 momentum calibration benchmark on US equities. Practical viability requires three predeclared gates: statistical Sharpe-gap edge after Benjamini–Yekutieli multiplicity control, economic CAGR gap net of ~10bps round-trip retail costs, and finite-bankroll survival under FINRA/ESMA leverage scenarios. Oscillator, volume, calendar, and candlestick are REFUTED (claim-excluding intervals); trend and diversified momentum are INCONCLUSIVE; none is SUPPORTED. Binding constraint under retail-realistic US margin is edge+costs, not ruin. Site takeaway: do not promote retail TA folklore as live screens; keep momentum/SMA only as watched candidates while olympiad math gate remains closed.
formulas: sharpe_gap ← Sharpe(signal) − Sharpe(exposure_matched_benchmark); REFUTED if CI_upper < δ_S (δ_S≈0.20)
cagr_gap_net ← CAGR(signal) − CAGR(matched) − retail_cost_bps; REFUTED if CI_upper < δ_R (δ_R≈0.01)
survival ← P(forced_liquidation | leverage, maintenance_margin) over bootstrap paths; fail if CI_upper ≥ 0.10
joint ← SUPPORTED iff statistical=SUPPORTED AND economic=SUPPORTED AND survival=SURVIVES; else REFUTED if any gate REFUTED else INCONCLUSIVE

items.title: CrossAlpha: An Annual-Report Benchmark for Cross-Market Factor Research (with LLM Agents)
items.summary: Public cross-market annual-report benchmark covering ~3,600 firms across US, Japan, Taiwan (TWSE/MOPS), Korea, and Hong Kong. LLM disclosure distillation into a shared ten-category English schema, PCA-whitened residual schema graphs (~19M directed firm-pair scores), and timing-aligned evaluation on ~11 years of daily OHLCV. Disclosure-derived cross-market peers beat domestic text, GICS, and return-correlation peers (e.g. US→JP ICIR 0.39 vs 0.07–0.18); US→TW peer-momentum shows strong reported ICIR/Sharpe in the paper’s tables. TW domestic text peers can still beat cross-market sources (semiconductor cluster). Site takeaway: filing-text peer momentum / US→TW spillover is a BOTH-market watch candidate only — needs public reproducible peers and math-gate clearance before any live screen.
formulas: s_text(i,j) ← mean_c cos(z_i^(c), z_j^(c)) over 10 residual schema categories after PCA whitening
peer_momentum_factor(i) ← similarity_weighted mean of source peers’ lagged sector-relative returns
IC ← Spearman(rank(factor), next_month_return); ICIR ← annualized mean(IC)/std(IC)
watch: US→TW / TW→KR directed spillover flags (candidate only; no live adoption)

items.title: Capital liquidity and abnormal returns in the Taiwan stock market: The impact of the US-China trade conflict and the COVID-19 pandemic
items.summary: Studies how capital-flow liquidity relates to abnormal returns on Taiwan equities around two external-risk episodes: the US–China trade conflict and COVID-19. Beyond transaction-cost frictions, higher external risk can slow liquidity and produce sharp abnormal moves. Public abstract evidence: trade-war period associated with higher capital liquidity in TW; COVID period with lower liquidity; illiquidity significantly linked to abnormal returns. Site takeaway: treat TW liquidity / crisis-regime flags as research candidates only — keep US/TW separate and do not change live screener math while the olympiad gate is closed.

abnormal_return ← realized_return − expected_benchmark_return over event windows
regime_flag ← trade_war | covid | calm (external-risk calendar)
gate: TW-only candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.title: Investor Contributions to Price Discovery and Trading Performance: Evidence from the Taiwan Stock Exchange
items.summary: Open-access TWSE microstructure study linking investor-type information shares (IS) to trading performance on five-second intraday data (call-auction era sample). Institutions show higher IS per order than individuals and better trading performance; higher IS associates with better contemporaneous outcomes but does not predict long-horizon performance. Determinants include investor type, price aggressiveness, trade size, herding, firm traits, and macro conditions. Site takeaway: public institutional-flow / herding awareness for TW is a watch candidate only — not a live screen while math gate is closed.

scaled_IS ← IS / order_count (per-thousand-orders) for cross-type comparison
perf(t,t+τ) ← signed buy–sell imbalance × subsequent returns over horizon τ

items.title: The Intramonth Momentum Cycle
items.summary: Shows U.S. equity momentum returns concentrate in a six-trading-day pre-turn-of-the-month window ending four days before month-end, driven mainly by losers sold for month-end cash needs rather than winners winning. Over 1980–2025 the PreTOM WML path compounds far more than rest-of-month; SEC T+2→T+1 settlement shifts selling pressure one day later as predicted; pattern appears across 19 developed markets. Site takeaway: calendar / settlement-aware momentum timing is a US watch candidate only — do not harden into live screens while math gate is closed.
formulas: PreTOM ← trading days [τ−9, τ−4] relative to month-end τ
WML_t ← VW(top_mom_decile) − VW(bottom_mom_decile); deciles fixed within calendar month (12–2 sort)
Loser×PreTOM ← panel underperformance of D1 vs market on PreTOM days
gate: US-only candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes

僅作美股日曆／結算感知動能觀察候選；數學閘門通過前不上線

items.title: Trended Momentum
items.summary: JFQA study arguing that how clearly prices trend during the formation window matters for momentum, not only cumulative past return. Trend clarity (TC) is the R² from regressing daily price on time over months t−11 to t−1 (skipping t); high-TC momentum quintiles earn about 12.68% annualized versus about 6.90% for conventional momentum. Fits Hong–Stein multi-period chasing and appears across assets/global markets. Site takeaway: path-quality / R²-conditioned momentum is a US watch candidate only — do not harden into live screens while the olympiad math gate is closed.
formulas: TC ← R² of OLS(price_day ~ time) over formation days in [t−11, t−1] (skip month t)
mom_ret ← cumulative return over same formation window (standard 12–2 style)
trended_mom ← intersect high_mom with high_TC quintile (or double-sort TC within mom)
gate: US-primary candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 美股：同樣過去報酬，價格走勢愈「清楚」（趨勢 R² 高）的動能組合，後續報酬通常更強
趨勢清晰度是路徑條件變數，不是只看累積漲幅；與資訊離散度（ID）相關但不同
僅作美股路徑品質／趨勢清晰動能觀察候選；數學閘門通過前不上線

items.title: Geopolitical Risks and Foreign Institutional Investors: Evidence from the Taiwan Stock Market
items.summary: Difference-in-differences event study of Taiwan equities around the 2022 Russia–Ukraine war outbreak, comparing firms in the top vs bottom 30% of foreign institutional ownership (TEJ data). High-foreign-ownership firms see roughly 14.65% drop in foreign ownership, larger losses, and higher volume, Parkinson volatility, and turnover; effects stronger for weaker operations, higher risk, and more liquid names; 3–/6-month buy-and-hold returns underperform. Site takeaway: TW foreign-ownership / geopolitical-shock stress flags are research candidates only — keep US/TW separate and do not change live screener math while the olympiad gate is closed.

items.title: Speculative Leverage and Factor Momentum
items.summary: Studies time-series factor momentum (long recently winning factors, short losers) across 201 U.S. equity factors. Since the late 1990s the strategy strengthens after quarters of rapid aggregate margin-debt growth: a one-standard-deviation rise in lagged quarterly margin-debt growth lifts nearest-horizon, stock-momentum-free abnormal returns by about 49 bp/month. Effect fades as the signal ages, concentrates in hard-to-arbitrage factors, is not absorbed by risk/uncertainty/credit controls, and holds out of sample vs a historical-mean benchmark. After anomalies are published, factor return levels decay while factor momentum persists. Site takeaway: margin-debt / speculative-leverage regime as a US factor-momentum overlay is a watch candidate only — do not harden into live screens while the olympiad gate is closed.
formulas: TS_factor_mom ← long factors with positive recent return, short factors with negative recent return (201 equity factors)
signal_boost ← +1σ lagged quarterly margin_debt_growth → ~+49 bp/month nearest-horizon stock-mom-free alpha (study estimate)
decay ← predictability weakens monotonically as momentum lookback ages; stronger among hard-to-arbitrage factors
gate: US-only candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 美股：因子動能（追最近強、空最近弱）在融資餘額季增偏快之後明顯變強

僅作美股融資／槓桿體制下的因子動能觀察候選；數學閘門通過前不上線

items.title: Momentum in Machine Learning: Evidence from the Taiwan Stock Market
items.summary: Revisits 86 asset-pricing anomalies in Taiwan equities and shows machine-learning long-short portfolios (e.g. neural nets, partial least squares) deliver roughly 1.20%–1.50% per month. Five of the top-20 most influential return predictors are momentum-related — notable because Taiwan is often cited as a classic exception to the momentum anomaly. Takeaway for the site: TW momentum features may still matter inside multivariate / ML-style screens even when simple 12–2 long-short looks weak; keep as a Taiwan-only research candidate and do not change live screener math while the olympiad gate is closed.

items.title: Monetary Policy Surprises and the Cross Sectional Stock Return Predictability in Volume Sorted Portfolios
items.summary: Asks whether Fed policy news predicts a specific stock-return anomaly rather than just the overall market. The anomaly is the high-volume return premium: stocks that recently had an unusually large jump in trading volume tend to earn higher average returns afterward. The study finds that surprises in the Fed's forward guidance (what it signals about the future rate path) help predict this premium, while surprises in the current rate decision do not. The link is about twice as strong after unscheduled FOMC meetings, and it disappears in the zero-lower-bound era. Takeaway for the site: a volume-shock screen may be worth tilting toward or away from depending on the latest guidance surprise — an interest-rate-aware overlay to watch, not a live rule.
formulas: volume_shock(stock) ← recent volume unusually high vs its own trailing history (study's volume-sort definition)
premium_t ← return(high-volume-shock portfolio) − return(low-volume-shock portfolio)
guidance_surprise ← FOMC forward-guidance (path) surprise; action_surprise ← current-rate surprise
regress premium_{t+1} on guidance_surprise_t and action_surprise_t; only guidance is significant in study
flags: unscheduled meeting ≈ 2× effect; no effect in zero-lower-bound period
gate: US-only candidate overlay; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.title: The impact of trading mechanism reforms on behavioral biases: Evidence from Taiwan stock market
items.summary: Uses the Taiwan Stock Exchange's March 2020 switch from periodic call auctions to continuous trading as a natural experiment. Working from daily margin buy and sell data for 768 listed firms (margin trading in Taiwan is overwhelmingly retail), it builds stock-level measures of two retail biases: the disposition effect (selling winners too early, holding losers too long) and overconfidence (chasing past returns). Both biases rose clearly after the reform, and the rise was largest in stocks that retail investors already dominated; return-based checks agree. Takeaway for the site: in retail-heavy, margin-heavy Taiwan names, crowd behavior has become more reactive since 2020 — a psychology/crowding flag to watch alongside Kostolany-style sentiment rules, not a live rule.
formulas: universe ← TWSE listed firms with daily margin buy/sell data
retail_dominance(stock) ← pre-reform margin usage ratio (margin balance relative to shares/turnover)
disposition / overconfidence ← stock-level coefficients of margin selling and buying on past gains/returns (Weber–Camerer, Dhar–Zhu style proxies)
DiD: bias_post2020 − bias_pre2020, high vs low retail_dominance → larger rise in retail-heavy stocks
gate: TW-only crowding/psychology candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.title: Asymmetric Reversals
items.summary: Splits each stock's short-term return into two pieces: the part explained by systematic risk and public news (SYS) and the leftover firm-specific residual (RES). The SYS part tends to keep going, while the RES part reverses. The reversal is lopsided: residual drops bounce back faster than residual jumps fade. A factor built on this asymmetric residual reversal absorbs the idiosyncratic-volatility effect and several other short-horizon anomalies. Takeaway for the site: a big one-month move with no news behind it — especially a drop — is more likely to retrace than a news-driven move, so the existing chase-high and pullback rules could someday check whether a move was news-backed. Watch-only candidate.
formulas: r_i,t = SYS_i,t + RES_i,t  (SYS ← fitted part from factor exposures + public-information/news days; RES ← residual)
signal_cont ← +SYS_i,t−1  (continuation)
signal_rev ← −RES_i,t−1, scaled more strongly when RES_i,t−1 < 0 (negative residual shocks revert faster)
AIR factor ← long/short on asymmetric residual reversal; reported to subsume IVOL and other short-horizon anomalies
gate: US-only short-horizon candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 把個股短期漲跌拆成兩塊：一塊是大盤、產業與公開消息能解釋的，另一塊是公司自己「說不出原因」的波動

items.title: Short-Term Reversal Persists Globally — If Properly Measured
items.summary: Asks why the classic one-month reversal effect (last month's losers beat last month's winners) seems to have faded in stock markets worldwide. Across 64 countries, the plain version earns almost nothing, but measuring each stock's move relative to its own industry brings it back: the industry-adjusted version earns about 0.53% a month with a Sharpe ratio around 0.74. The reason is that industry moves tend to persist while a single company's move against its peers tends to undo itself; mixing the two hides the effect. Takeaway for the site, in both the US and Taiwan books: when judging whether a stock is 'overextended' or 'oversold', compare it with its own sector, not just with its own past price. Watch-only candidate.
formulas: raw_rev_i ← −r_i,t−1 (prior-month return)
ind_adj_rev_i ← −(r_i,t−1 − r_industry(i),t−1)
sort by ind_adj_rev within each market (US and TW computed separately, never pooled)
reported: raw ≈ 0; industry-adjusted ≈ 0.53%/month, Sharpe ≈ 0.74 (64 countries)
gate: per-market candidate; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 「上個月跌最多的下個月反彈」這個老現象看似失效，其實是量法錯了

items.title: The impact and profitability of day trading following the relaxation of day trading restrictions in Taiwan
items.summary: Studies Taiwan after day-trading limits were loosened at the start of 2016, when day-trading volume rose sharply. Using time-series models, it finds that heavy overall market volume draws in day traders, but heavy day trading does not pull in broader market volume. Day trading turned out more profitable when the VIX was high, likely because volatile markets widen intraday price ranges. Unexpected surges in day-trading volume were more likely than unexpected market-volume surges to raise volatility and returns. Takeaway for the site: a sudden spike in a Taiwan stock's day-trading share signals speculative, short-lived heat rather than lasting demand — a crowding flag to watch, not a buy reason.
formulas: dt_ratio_t ← day-trading volume / total volume (TWSE public daily statistics)

dt profitability conditioned on VIX level (higher when VIX high)

items.title: Earnings Persistence Cliff and Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift
items.summary: Finds that how much one quarter's earnings surprise carries into the next is steady within a fiscal year but drops sharply from the fourth fiscal quarter to the next year's first quarter. Investors learn to treat first-quarter surprises as less lasting than they really are, so prices underreact and the drift after first-quarter reports is roughly 83% larger than after other quarters. That first-quarter drift is still meaningful after the mid-2000s, when the overall post-earnings drift has largely faded, and it is not explained by microcaps, surprise streaks, calendar effects, or earnings management. Takeaway for the site: if earnings-drift ideas are ever used for US picks, a first-fiscal-quarter beat deserves more weight than a beat in other quarters — a watch item only.
formulas: SUE_q ← (actual EPS − consensus or seasonal-random-walk EPS) / σ(past surprises) (from public earnings data)
fq ← fiscal quarter of the report (FQ1 = first quarter after fiscal year end)
persistence ← slope of SUE_q on SUE_{q−1}; stable within year, sharply lower for FQ4→FQ1
drift window ← cumulative abnormal return over days +2…+60 after the announcement, by SUE bucket
candidate rule: weight FQ1 positive surprises above other-quarter surprises
gate: US-only earnings-drift watch; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 同一財年內，一季財報的「意外」對下一季很有延續性，但從第四季跨到隔年第一季時延續性明顯斷掉
投資人因此低估第一季意外的持續性，股價反應不足，第一季財報後的漂移比其他季大約多 83%
整體財報後漂移在 2000 年代中期後大多消失，但第一季這段仍明顯存在
本站僅作美股觀察：若未來用財報漂移選股，第一財季優於預期的權重可較高，目前不當買進理由

Overall post-earnings drift mostly faded after the mid-2000s, but the Q1 portion is still clearly present

items.title: Detecting price manipulation in the Taiwan stock market using intraday equity returns
items.summary: Uses Taiwan Stock Exchange intraday data to look for prices being pushed up at period ends to make portfolios look better. It finds a clear seasonal pattern of end-of-period price lifts followed by reversals, strongest at the turn of the year, and stronger in riskier stocks. Mutual funds that dress up their holdings the most show the sharpest reversals afterward. Order imbalances from foreign investors and investment trusts (投信) near the session close and open line up with the size of the reversals, and investment trusts show the strongest year-end inflation, while individual investors do not. Takeaway for the site: a sharp late-December closing run-up in a Taiwan stock heavily held by 投信 may be window dressing that tends to give back, so treat it as a caution flag rather than real strength.
formulas: close-to-open reversal_t ← (open_{t+1} − close_t) / close_t, measured at quarter-end and year-end sessions
year-end flag ← last trading days of December vs other quarter-ends (stronger at year-end)
inst. net buy near close ← 投信／外資 daily net buy (TWSE public 三大法人 data) on period-end days
caution rule: large period-end close-up + heavy 投信 net buy → expect partial reversal early next period
gate: TW-only window-dressing caution flag; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 台股在季底、尤其年底，常出現收盤被拉高、隔期開盤又跌回的「作帳」現象
風險較高的股票年底作帳更明顯，作帳最多的股票型基金之後回吐也最大
投信與外資在收盤前後的買賣失衡和回吐幅度高度相關，其中投信年底作帳最明顯，散戶則沒有
本站僅作台股觀察：年底尾盤急拉、又是投信重倉的個股，應視為可能回吐的警訊，不當作真正轉強

items.title: The Capacity of Equity Anomalies
items.summary: Measures how much money can be put into 35 well-known US stock anomalies before trading costs wipe out their market-hedged returns above cash, using daily estimates of bid-ask spreads, price impact and how fast liquidity comes back. The strategies with the highest paper returns hold up only at small scale, while lower-return profitability strategies can absorb far more money. Price impact, driven by how often a strategy trades and how liquid its stocks are, explains most of the difference. Trading more slowly, rather than rebalancing fully every time, raises typical capacity many times over. Takeaway for the site: a strategy's paper return overstates what it keeps after costs; favoring liquid names and lower turnover in the paper-trading book is the honest way to evaluate US candidates.
formulas: net return ← gross anomaly return − (half-spread + price impact) × turnover
capacity ← largest capital where market-hedged net return over cash stays > 0
partial adjustment: trade only a fraction of the gap to the target weight each rebalance to cut turnover
candidate rule for US paper book: report turnover and estimated cost per strategy; prefer liquid, lower-turnover variants when gross edges are similar
gate: evaluation/cost-model candidate only; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 研究 35 種美股常見選股異常，算出扣掉交易成本後，各策略最多能放多少錢還賺得到超額報酬
帳面報酬最高的策略，往往只能小規模操作；報酬較低的獲利能力類策略反而能容納更多資金
差異主要來自價格衝擊：換股越頻繁、個股越不流通，成本吃掉越多
放慢換股、每次只調整一部分，可大幅提高可操作規模；本站美股僅作觀察，模擬單評估應計入週轉與成本

items.title: Is There a Turnover Anomaly in the Taiwan Stock Market?
items.summary: Studies whether trading turnover predicts future returns in Taiwan. Stocks that change hands the least earn higher later returns than the most heavily traded ones, and the gap lasts up to about two years. Standard risk factors, liquidity measures, trading costs, industry effects and the January effect do not explain it. Most of the gap comes from the heavily traded stocks doing badly afterward, and the effect is stronger when short selling is harder and when investor sentiment runs hot, which points to overpricing of popular names. Takeaway for the site: in Taiwan, unusually high turnover is a caution sign for future returns rather than a sign of strength, which matters because the screener rewards high volume ratios.
formulas: turnover_i ← average daily shares traded / shares outstanding over a trailing window (TWSE/TPEx public data)
rank stocks by turnover each month; compare lowest-turnover bucket vs highest-turnover bucket forward returns
caution rule: top-decile turnover in TW → down-weight as overpricing risk, especially when 融券 constraints bind or sentiment is high
interaction check vs live volume-ratio rule: a volume spike is not the same as persistently high turnover
gate: TW-only caution flag; no live screener change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 台股中成交週轉率最低的股票，之後報酬比週轉率最高的股票好，差距可延續約兩年
這個現象用常見風險因子、流動性、交易成本、產業或一月效應都解釋不了
差距主要來自「交易最熱的股票之後表現差」，放空受限或市場情緒高時更明顯
本站僅作台股觀察：長期週轉率異常高的熱門股要當作過熱警訊，不能只因量大就視為轉強

TW watch only: persistently very high turnover is an overheating warning, not proof of strength just because volume is big

items.title: Left Tail Risk Without Reward: Evidence from Taiwan's Stock Market
items.summary: National Taiwan University master's thesis (advisor 廖咸興) on Taiwan listed stocks from 2000 to 2024. It measures each stock's left-tail risk, meaning how badly it tends to fall on its worst days (Value-at-Risk), and finds that the stocks with the worst left tails do not pay investors back: after adjusting for market risk they underperform the stocks with mild left tails, more clearly over longer holding periods. Whether tail risk has recently risen or fallen does not change this. The effect is concentrated in stocks with low institutional ownership, i.e. the retail-heavy part of the market, and fades in the most institution-held names. Takeaway for the site: in Taiwan, a history of sharp single-day crashes is a reason for caution, not a sign of higher expected reward.
formulas: left_tail_i ← how large stock i's worst daily losses are over a trailing window (Value-at-Risk); site choice for testing: 5th-percentile daily return over the past ~250 trading days — the thesis's exact window is not in the public abstract
each month sort TW stocks by left_tail into groups; compare the worst-tail group vs the mildest-tail group on market-adjusted forward returns
split the comparison by institutional ownership (三大法人 / 外資持股比例, public TWSE data): expect the gap mainly in low-ownership stocks
caution rule candidate: TW stock in worst left-tail group AND low institutional ownership → down-weight, do not treat as higher-reward
gate: TW-only watch flag; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.title: Forecast Accuracy Is Not Trading Profit: Evolving Small Recurrent Networks for Stock Return Prediction
items.summary: Compares many stock-forecasting models (a linear model, standard recurrent networks, several transformers and a mixing model) against tiny recurrent networks found by an evolutionary search, on four 50-stock US mid-cap portfolios from S&P 500 names, tested on 2022, 2023 and 2024. Each model's forecasts drive the same daily long/short book (top 10 long, bottom 10 short) with half the bid-ask spread charged on every trade. The key lesson: the model with the second-best forecast accuracy still lost money once trades and costs were counted, so accuracy alone is the wrong yardstick. The tiny evolved networks (about 66 weights) did best on accuracy, net return, Sharpe and drawdown, and their edge survived controls for short-term reversal, but the confidence range is wide and the stock lists carry survivorship bias. Takeaway for the site: judge any new rule by after-cost paper-trading results and check it is not just short-term reversal in disguise.
formulas: net_return ← strategy return after charging half the quoted spread, ½ × (ask − bid), on every buy and sell
rebalance gate: only trade when all K long picks have positive forecasts and all K short picks negative; otherwise keep holding (fewer trades, lower cost)
rank IC ← correlation between forecast ranking and actual return ranking across stocks, checked at 1-day and 10-day horizons
reversal check: regress strategy daily returns on market + 1-day and 5-day reversal portfolios; alpha must survive
site use: validation checklist for paper books only; no live screener change until math gate passes

items.summary: Uses intraday data on Taiwan-listed firms that announce record-high monthly revenue. The day after the announcement, prices tend to open too high and then slip back during the session, especially for stocks that had already run up before the news, carry high share prices, and show fast revenue growth — a sign of attention-driven buying and overconfidence. Over the following 20 trading days, though, a buy-and-hold position started after the announcement earns significantly positive returns, i.e. the good news is absorbed slowly (a revenue version of post-earnings drift). When institutions were net sellers before the announcement, the next-day pullback is larger and the later recovery stronger. Takeaway for the site: a record-revenue flag is worth testing as a TW paper-book rule, but entries should avoid chasing the next-day open.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 台股月營收創新高公告後：隔天開盤常被追高、盤中回落（事前已大漲、高價、營收成長快的股票最明顯）；但公告後買進持有 20 個交易日有顯著正報酬，好消息是慢慢反映。公告前法人賣超時，隔天回落更大、之後反彈更強。本站列為台股候選規則，不改即時選股。

summaryLocalized.en: Taiwan record monthly revenue: the next-day open tends to be chased and fades intraday (strongest after big pre-news run-ups, high prices, fast growth), yet buy-and-hold from the announcement earns significant gains over 20 trading days. Candidate TW rule only.

formulas: record_rev_flag ← this month's revenue > every prior monthly revenue on file for the company (TWSE/TPEx monthly revenue filings, published by the 10th)
entry rule: do not buy at the next-day open; enter at a later close (e.g. day+1 close or after the first pullback) to avoid the attention-driven opening overshoot
hold window: measure paper-book return from entry to 20 trading days later, after TW costs (0.1425% fee each side, 0.3% sell tax)
caution flags (bigger next-day fade): pre-announcement run-up in top group, high share price, very fast revenue growth
institutional overlay: three-institution net selling in the days before the announcement → expect larger next-day pullback and stronger later recovery

items.summary: Instead of having a model pick individual option contracts, the agent chooses one of nine strategy families (outright, debit/credit vertical, risk reversal, straddle, strangle, iron butterfly, iron condor, butterfly) plus a tenor and delta targets, and fixed rules then pick the contracts, size the trade and delta-hedge. The market picture it sees is ten option-chain measures per stock: recent return, 21-day realized volatility, 30-day at-the-money implied volatility and its daily change, implied minus realized volatility, the 90-day vs 30-day slope, put-vs-call skew, smile curvature, option order-flow imbalance and open-interest change. Tested on SPY and nine large US stocks (AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, META, MSFT, MU, NVDA, PLTR, TSLA) from March to August 2025, the trained agent made +18.3% with an 8.96% max drawdown while simple rule-based and machine-learning selectors all lost money; feeding news during training hurt results. The test window is only six months. Takeaway for the site: the ten-measure dashboard and the strategy-family menu map neatly onto McMillan's strategy families for the US options section; the AI agent itself is not adopted.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 讓模型先選「策略類型」（垂直價差、跨式、鐵兀鷹等九種）再由固定規則挑合約、定部位與避險；判斷依據是每檔十個選擇權指標（隱含與實際波動差、期限結構、偏斜、微笑曲率、買賣流向等）。2025 年 3–8 月測 SPY 與九檔美股大型股，賺 18.3%、最大回撤 8.96%，規則與傳統機器學習方法都虧損；但只測半年。本站借用指標與策略分類補強美股選擇權區（對照 McMillan），不採用 AI 代理本身。

summaryLocalized.en: Agent picks one of nine option strategy families from ten option-chain measures; fixed rules pick contracts and hedge. SPY + nine US large caps, Mar–Aug 2025: +18.3%, 8.96% max drawdown, baselines all lost. Only six months tested; the site borrows the measures and strategy menu for the US options section.
summaryLocalized.ja: 9種類のオプション戦略から10個の指標で選択、契約選定とヘッジは固定ルール。SPYと米大型9銘柄（2025年3–8月）で+18.3%、最大DD8.96%。検証は半年のみ。本サイトは指標と戦略分類のみ米国オプション欄に活用。

formulas: rv21 ← sqrt(252/21 × sum of the last 21 squared daily log returns) — realized volatility, annualized
iv_rv_wedge ← 30-day at-the-money implied vol − rv21 (also as ratio iv/rv: ≤0.90 = options cheap, ≥1.25 = options rich)
term_slope ← 90-day ATM implied vol − 30-day ATM implied vol (negative = near-term stress)
skew ← 30-day 25-delta put implied vol − 30-day 25-delta call implied vol
curvature ← average(25-delta put IV, 25-delta call IV) − ATM IV
strategy menu: map readings to McMillan families (cheap vol → long straddle/strangle; rich vol → iron condor/iron butterfly; directional → debit vertical) with defined risk only

items.title: How volatility model specification affects volatility targeting performance: Evidence from Taiwan

titleLocalized.en: How volatility model specification affects volatility targeting performance: Evidence from Taiwan
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 波動度模型設定如何影響「波動度目標」配置績效：台灣證據
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 波动率模型设定如何影响“波动率目标”配置绩效：台湾证据
titleLocalized.ja: ボラティリティ・モデルの設定がボラティリティ・ターゲティングの成果に与える影響：台湾の実証

items.summary: Studies volatility targeting in Taiwan: hold more stock when expected volatility is low and less when it is high. The authors compare several ways of forecasting the TAIEX's day-to-day volatility, including a model that allows for sudden price jumps, and pair them with a conditional rule (after Bongaerts et al., 2020) that only changes exposure when volatility is unusually high or low. On the TAIEX, the jump-aware forecast combined with the conditional rule gave the best portfolio results, and the effect differed across the financial, semiconductor and food sector indices. Main lesson: how you forecast volatility changes the outcome, so the forecast has to fit how Taiwan returns actually behave. Takeaway for the site: a candidate position-sizing rule for the TW paper book that builds on the ATR% risk gauge already on the market-regime panel; it is not a stock-picking signal.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究台股的「波動度目標」配置：預期波動低時多持股、波動高時少持股。作者比較多種預測加權指數波動的方法（含可處理突然跳空的模型），再搭配「只在波動特別高或特別低時才調整部位」的條件式規則（Bongaerts 等人，2020）。在加權指數上，可處理跳空的預測加上條件式規則績效最好；金融、半導體、食品類股指數的效果各不相同。重點：波動怎麼估會直接影響結果。本站把它列為台股模擬倉的部位大小候選規則，延伸市場狀態區已有的 ATR% 風險指標，不是選股訊號。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究台股的“波动率目标”配置：预期波动低时多持股、波动高时少持股。作者比较多种预测加权指数波动的方法（含可处理突然跳空的模型），再搭配“只在波动特别高或特别低时才调整仓位”的条件式规则（Bongaerts 等人，2020）。在加权指数上，可处理跳空的预测加上条件式规则绩效最好；金融、半导体、食品类股指数的效果各不相同。重点：波动怎么估会直接影响结果。本站把它列为台股模拟仓的仓位大小候选规则，延伸市场状态区已有的 ATR% 风险指标，不是选股信号。
summaryLocalized.en: Volatility targeting on the TAIEX: hold more when expected volatility is low, less when high. A jump-aware volatility forecast plus a rule that only adjusts exposure in unusually calm or stormy markets worked best; sector indices (financials, semis, food) reacted differently. The site lists it as a TW paper-book position-sizing candidate built on the existing ATR% gauge.
summaryLocalized.ja: 台湾加権指数でのボラティリティ・ターゲティング。ジャンプを考慮した予測と、ボラが極端に高い／低い時だけ配分を変える条件付きルールの組み合わせが最良。金融・半導体・食品で効果は異なる。本サイトは既存のATR%指標を土台に、台湾模擬口座のポジション・サイズ候補として掲載。

formulas: vol_now ← annualized volatility of TAIEX daily log returns (site already has ATR% on the market-regime panel as a simpler stand-in)
vol_band ← where vol_now sits versus its own past (e.g. bottom third / middle / top third of the last 3 years)

conditional sizing (site proposal): middle band → keep normal exposure; top band → exposure = target_vol ÷ vol_now; bottom band → allow up to a capped increase; never above 100% (no leverage in the paper book)
check: compare against fixed 100% exposure on return, max drawdown and turnover after TW costs (0.1425% fee each side, 0.3% sell tax)
sector check: run separately for financials, semiconductors and food indices because the paper finds different effects by sector
site use: TW paper-book position-sizing candidate only; does not change which stocks are picked; no live change until math gate passes
plainTakeaways: 市場越動盪就少放一點錢，越平靜就正常或多放一點，目的是讓整體風險維持在差不多的水準

用能處理突然大跳空的方法來估波動，在台股加權指數上效果最好

en: Put less money in when the market is stormy and a normal or slightly larger amount when it is calm, so overall risk stays roughly steady
Only adjust when volatility is unusually high or low and leave it alone otherwise, which avoids a lot of needless trading

items.title: From Economic Explanation to Performance Improvement in Machine-Learning Portfolios

titleLocalized.en: From Economic Explanation to Performance Improvement in Machine-Learning Portfolios

titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 从经济解释到绩效提升：机器学习投资组合

items.summary: Asks a practical question: which inputs to a trading model actually make money after trading costs, not just which ones the model leans on. The authors trace each signal's effect from position weights through turnover, return and volatility to the after-cost Sharpe ratio, then turn the dial up on signals that helped in the previous year and down on those that hurt, without retraining the model. On 346 large, liquid US stocks traded daily from 2006 to 2024 (5 basis points cost per unit of turnover), the after-cost Sharpe ratio rose from about 0.58 to 0.83 for a neural-network version, mostly because daily turnover fell from 26.7% to 13.0%, and from about 0.62 to 0.76 for a boosted-tree version. Key finding: some fast signals look good before costs but lose money after costs because they make the portfolio trade too much. Takeaway for the site: score every US rule on after-cost results and turnover, and favour signals whose contribution is steady from year to year; the machine-learning models themselves are not adopted.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 問一個實際問題：交易模型用的各個訊號，扣掉交易成本後到底誰在賺錢。作者把每個訊號的影響一路追到部位、週轉、報酬、波動，最後到扣成本後的夏普值，再把前一年有幫助的訊號調大、有拖累的調小，模型本身不重訓。在 346 檔美股大型流動股、2006–2024 每日交易（每單位週轉成本 5 個基點）上，神經網路版扣成本夏普值由約 0.58 升到 0.83，主要因每日週轉由 26.7% 降到 13.0%；樹模型版由約 0.62 升到 0.76。重點：有些短線訊號扣成本前好看，扣成本後反而虧錢，因為讓組合交易太頻繁。本站借用「每條美股規則都看扣成本後成績與週轉率」的評估方式，不採用機器學習模型本身。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 问一个实际问题：交易模型用的各个信号，扣掉交易成本后到底谁在赚钱。作者把每个信号的影响一路追到仓位、换手、报酬、波动，最后到扣成本后的夏普值，再把前一年有帮助的信号调大、有拖累的调小，模型本身不重训。在 346 档美股大型流动股、2006–2024 每日交易（每单位换手成本 5 个基点）上，神经网络版扣成本夏普值由约 0.58 升到 0.83，主要因每日换手由 26.7% 降到 13.0%；树模型版由约 0.62 升到 0.76。重点：有些短线信号扣成本前好看，扣成本后反而亏钱，因为让组合交易太频繁。本站借用“每条美股规则都看扣成本后成绩与换手率”的评估方式，不采用机器学习模型本身。
summaryLocalized.en: Traces each signal's effect to the after-cost Sharpe ratio and re-weights signals using the prior year's after-cost contribution, without retraining. On 346 liquid US stocks, 2006–2024, after-cost Sharpe rose from ~0.58 to 0.83 (turnover 26.7% to 13.0%) for a neural net and ~0.62 to 0.76 for boosted trees. Fast signals can win before costs and lose after. The site borrows the after-cost, turnover-aware scoring; the ML models are not adopted.
summaryLocalized.ja: 各シグナルの影響を取引コスト控除後のシャープレシオまで追跡し、前年のコスト後貢献で再調整（再学習なし）。米大型流動株346銘柄・2006–2024年で、NN版はコスト後シャープ約0.58→0.83（回転率26.7%→13.0%）、木モデル版は約0.62→0.76。短期シグナルはコスト前は良くてもコスト後は損失になり得る。本サイトはコスト後・回転率重視の評価方法のみ採用。

formulas: turnover_t ← sum over stocks of |weight today − weight yesterday| (one full swap of the book = 2.0)
net_return_t ← gross_return_t − cost_rate × turnover_t (paper uses 5 basis points per unit of turnover)
net_sharpe ← sqrt(252) × average(net_return) ÷ standard deviation(net_return)
signal check (site proposal): for each US rule, compare paper-book results with the rule switched on vs off, both before and after costs; flag rules that help before costs but hurt after

re-weighting (site proposal): next year's weight for a rule × (1 + 0.5 × a bounded score of last year's after-cost contribution), clipped to a safe range so no rule is switched fully on or off in one step

items.title: The impact of the new day-trading alert system on the Taiwan stock market

titleLocalized.en: The impact of the new day-trading alert system on the Taiwan stock market
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 台灣證交所新版當沖警示制度對台股的影響
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 台湾证交所新版当冲警示制度对台股的影响
titleLocalized.ja: 台湾証券取引所の新しいデイトレード警告制度が台湾株に与えた影響

items.summary: An event study of the day-trading alert announcements the Taiwan Stock Exchange started publishing on 27 Aug 2021. Stocks that appear on the alert list show clearly negative abnormal returns on the announcement day, and the weakness lasts for a few more days, so the alert itself creates short-term selling pressure. The drop is bigger for large-cap stocks and for stocks with a high margin-buying ratio, both signs of heavy retail participation. Main lesson: the alert works as a real market signal, especially in retail-driven names. Takeaway for the site: a candidate 'cool-off' filter for the TW screener and paper book (do not open a new buy on a name in the days right after it is put on the alert list); it does not create new picks.

summaryLocalized.en: Event study of TWSE day-trading alerts (since 27 Aug 2021): listed stocks fall on the alert day and stay weak for a few days, more so for large caps and high margin-buying names. The site lists it as a TW 'cool-off' filter candidate — skip new buys right after a stock is flagged.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究證交所 2021 年 8 月 27 日起實施的新版當沖警示公告。被列入警示名單的股票，公告當天出現明顯負的異常報酬，而且弱勢會延續好幾天，代表警示本身就帶來短期賣壓。大型股、融資使用率高的股票跌得更多，這兩類都是散戶參與度高的特徵。重點：警示公告是真正有效的市場訊號，尤其對散戶主導的股票。本站把它列為台股選股與模擬倉的「冷卻期」過濾候選：股票剛被列入警示的那幾天不新開買單；它不會產生新的選股。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究证交所 2021 年 8 月 27 日起实施的新版当冲警示公告。被列入警示名单的股票，公告当天出现明显负的异常报酬，而且弱势会延续好几天，代表警示本身就带来短期卖压。大型股、融资使用率高的股票跌得更多，这两类都是散户参与度高的特征。重点：警示公告是真正有效的市场信号，尤其对散户主导的股票。本站把它列为台股选股与模拟仓的“冷却期”过滤候选：股票刚被列入警示的那几天不新开买单；它不会产生新的选股。
summaryLocalized.ja: 台湾証券取引所が2021年8月27日に始めたデイトレード警告公告のイベントスタディ。警告銘柄は公告当日に明確なマイナスの異常リターンとなり、数日続く。大型株や信用買い比率の高い銘柄ほど下落が大きい。本サイトは台湾株スクリーナーと模擬口座の「クールダウン」フィルター候補として掲載（警告直後の数日は新規買いを見送る）。

plainTakeaways: 股票被證交所列入當沖警示的那天，平均會出現明顯的額外下跌
這股弱勢不是一天就結束，會再延續好幾天
大型股、融資買很多的股票（散戶多）跌得更明顯

这股弱势不是一天就结束，会再延续好几天

en: On the day a stock is put on the TWSE day-trading alert list, it tends to drop noticeably more than normal
The weakness does not end that day; it lasts for a few more days
Large caps and stocks bought heavily on margin (lots of retail traders) fall more
The site treats it only as a TW cool-off filter candidate: no new buys right after an alert; no live change until the math gate passes
ja: デイトレード警告に載った当日、株価は平常より目立って下がりやすい
弱さはその日で終わらず数日続く
大型株や信用買いの多い銘柄（個人投資家が多い）ほど下落が大きい

formulas: alert_t(i) ← 1 if stock i appears in the TWSE day-trading alert announcement on trading day t, else 0 (official TWSE public announcement; never inferred)
abnormal return (paper's event-study idea): AR(i,t) = r(i,t) − expected r(i,t) from a market model; CAR(0..k) = sum of AR from the alert day through day k
cool-off filter (site proposal): if alert_d(i)=1 for any d in the last N trading days (N≈3–5, to be tested), do not open a new paper-book buy in i; existing holdings follow normal exit rules
priority: apply the filter first to large caps and to stocks with a high margin-buying ratio, where the paper finds the strongest effect
check: compare TW paper-book results with and without the filter after TW costs (0.1425% fee each side, 0.3% sell tax) and on the count of skipped trades
site use: TW screener / paper-book exclusion candidate only; no live change until math gate passes

items.title: FOMO: FLEX Options and Market Outcomes

titleLocalized.en: FOMO: FLEX Options and Market Outcomes
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: FLEX 客製化選擇權與市場結果
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: FLEX 定制化期权与市场结果
titleLocalized.ja: FLEX オプションと市場への影響

items.summary: FLEX options are exchange-cleared contracts whose strike, expiry and style can be customized. Using about a year of data (Mar 2025–Mar 2026) on 41 US single names outside the S&P 500, the authors find that after a FLEX trade appears, open interest in the regular listed options of that stock rises versus matched peers, and FLEX activity clusters in stocks whose implied volatility is already high. The stock price moves only on the event day and the effect fades within a day, so it is not a direction signal. The most useful finding is about volatility: when implied volatility is well above recent realized volatility, a short straddle tended to make money even after bid-ask and fee costs, though the strongest subset was only 11 trades. Takeaway for the site: a watch item for the US options desk's 'option premium rich or cheap' explanation (McMillan's volatility chapters), not a trading rule.

summaryLocalized.en: Customized FLEX option trades in US single names (ex-S&P 500, Mar 2025–Mar 2026) are followed by more listed-option open interest and cluster in high-IV stocks; stock-price effects fade within a day. When implied volatility is far above recent realized volatility, short straddles tended to profit after costs, but on very few trades. Watch item for the US options desk's IV-vs-realized explanation.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: FLEX 是可以自訂履約價、到期日與型式、但仍由交易所結算的選擇權。作者用 2025 年 3 月到 2026 年 3 月、41 檔不在 S&P 500 的美股個股資料發現：出現 FLEX 交易後，該股一般上市選擇權的未平倉量相對同類股增加，而且 FLEX 交易多集中在隱含波動率本來就偏高的股票。股價只有當天有反應、隔天就消失，所以不能拿來猜漲跌。最有用的發現在波動率：隱含波動率明顯高於最近實際波動時，賣出跨式（同時賣買權和賣權）扣掉買賣價差與手續費後平均仍賺錢，但最強的那組只有 11 筆。本站把它列為美股選擇權區「權利金偏貴還是偏便宜」說明的觀察項目（對應 McMillan 波動率章節），不是交易規則。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: FLEX 是可以自定行权价、到期日与类型、但仍由交易所结算的期权。作者用 2025 年 3 月到 2026 年 3 月、41 只不在 S&P 500 的美股个股数据发现：出现 FLEX 交易后，该股一般上市期权的未平仓量相对同类股增加，而且 FLEX 交易多集中在隐含波动率本来就偏高的股票。股价只有当天有反应、隔天就消失，所以不能拿来猜涨跌。最有用的发现在波动率：隐含波动率明显高于最近实际波动时，卖出跨式扣掉买卖价差与手续费后平均仍赚钱，但最强的那组只有 11 笔。本站把它列为美股期权区“权利金偏贵还是偏便宜”说明的观察项目（对应 McMillan 波动率章节），不是交易规则。
summaryLocalized.ja: 権利行使価格や満期を自由に決められるFLEXオプション（米個別株、S&P500除く、2025年3月〜2026年3月）。取引後は通常オプションの建玉が増え、IVが高い銘柄に集中。株価への影響は当日のみ。IVが直近の実現ボラを大きく上回る時、コスト控除後もショート・ストラドルが平均で利益だったが、件数はごく少数。米国オプション欄のIV対実現ボラ解説の観察項目。

plainTakeaways: 大戶做客製化選擇權（FLEX）後，這檔股票的一般選擇權未平倉量會跟著變多
FLEX 多出現在權利金本來就偏貴（隱含波動率高）的股票
股價只有當天受影響，隔天就消失，不能拿來猜漲跌

FLEX 多出現在權利金本來就偏貴（隱含波動率高）的股票
股價只有當天受影響，隔天就消失，不能拿來猜漲跌
權利金明顯比最近實際波動貴時，賣方扣成本後平均有賺，但樣本很少；本站只當美股選擇權區的觀察項目
zh-Hans: 大户做定制化期权（FLEX）后，这只股票的一般期权未平仓量会跟着变多

en: After big players trade customized FLEX options on a stock, open interest in its regular options tends to rise
FLEX trades show up mostly in stocks whose option premiums are already expensive (high implied volatility)
The stock price is affected only on the day itself, so it cannot be used to guess direction
When premiums are much richer than recent actual moves, option sellers made money on average after costs, but on very few trades; watch item only
ja: 大口がFLEXを取引すると、その銘柄の通常オプションの建玉が増えやすい
FLEXはプレミアムがもともと高い（IVが高い）銘柄に多い
株価への影響は当日だけで、方向予測には使えない
プレミアムが実際の値動きより大幅に割高な時、売り手はコスト後も平均で利益だが件数は少ない。観察項目のみ

formulas: IV_atm ← median implied volatility of listed options with strike within ±5% of the stock price (public Yahoo options chain)
RV20 ← annualized standard deviation of the last 20 daily log returns × √252
rich_premium ← IV_atm − RV20 (positive = options priced for bigger moves than the stock has been making)
one-day expected move (paper's proxy): M ≈ 0.8 × IV_atm × √(1/252)
short-straddle one-day result after costs (paper's stress test): M × (1 − s/2) − |next-day return| × (1 + s/2) − fees, where s = relative bid-ask spread

site use: US options desk explanation only (label premiums 'rich' when IV_atm is well above RV20); no trades, no live screener change; paper sample excludes S&P 500 names and has only 11 trades in the best subset

items.title: Profit from analysts' earnings forecasts consensus? Evidence from Taiwan stock market

titleLocalized.en: Profit from analysts' earnings forecasts consensus? Evidence from Taiwan stock market
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 跟著分析師共識預估賺得到錢嗎？台股證據
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 跟着分析师共识预估赚得到钱吗？台股证据
titleLocalized.ja: アナリスト予想コンセンサスで儲けられるか？台湾株の実証

items.summary: Looks at two numbers built from analysts' consensus forecasts for Taiwan-listed firms: the expected earnings growth itself, and how that expected growth is revised up or down. Portfolios of stocks whose expected growth was just revised upward beat the Taiwan market index by about 2.1% a month on average, and buying upward-revised names while shorting downward-revised ones earned about 2.8% a month. The extra return keeps arriving for up to about a month after the revision is released, which suggests investors react too slowly. The level of expected growth only helps for firms that are expected to grow or in rising markets, while the direction of the revision helps consistently. Takeaway for the site: a TW screener candidate signal ('analysts just raised their growth estimate'), but it needs a public, dated source of consensus revisions before it can even be tested; paper results are before trading costs as reported in the abstract.

summaryLocalized.en: For Taiwan stocks, portfolios of names whose analyst consensus earnings-growth forecast was just revised up beat the index by about 2.1% a month (long-short about 2.8%), with the edge lasting up to a month — investors underreact. The direction of the revision matters more reliably than the growth level. TW screener candidate, pending a public dated revisions source.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究台股分析師共識預估裡的兩個數字：預估的盈餘成長率本身，以及這個預估被往上調或往下調。剛被分析師上修成長預估的股票組合，平均每月比台股大盤多賺約 2.1%；買上修股、放空下修股的組合每月約 2.8%。這份超額報酬在上修公布後還會延續約一個月，代表市場反應太慢。成長預估「高不高」只在公司本來就被看好成長、或大盤上漲時才有用；「往上還往下修」則一直有用。本站把它列為台股選股候選訊號（分析師剛上修成長預估），但必須先找到公開、有日期的共識預估修正資料才能測試；論文摘要裡的報酬未扣交易成本。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究台股分析师共识预估里的两个数字：预估的盈余成长率本身，以及这个预估被往上调或往下调。刚被分析师上修成长预估的股票组合，平均每月比台股大盘多赚约 2.1%；买上修股、放空下修股的组合每月约 2.8%。这份超额报酬在上修公布后还会延续约一个月，代表市场反应太慢。成长预估“高不高”只在公司本来就被看好成长、或大盘上涨时才有用；“往上还往下修”则一直有用。本站把它列为台股选股候选信号（分析师刚上修成长预估），但必须先找到公开、有日期的共识预估修正数据才能测试；论文摘要里的报酬未扣交易成本。
summaryLocalized.ja: 台湾株で、アナリスト・コンセンサスの利益成長予想が上方修正された銘柄群は指数を月約2.1%上回り（ロングショートで約2.8%）、効果は修正後約1か月続く＝市場の反応が遅い。成長率の水準より修正の方向の方が安定して効く。公開・日付付きの修正データが見つかるまでは台湾株スクリーナーの候補シグナル。

plainTakeaways: 分析師剛把一家公司的獲利成長預估往上調，這檔股票之後一個月平均會比大盤多漲
往上修還是往下修，比預估成長率本身高不高更可靠
超額報酬會慢慢出現、延續約一個月，代表市場消化消息比較慢
本站只當台股選股的候選訊號；要先有公開、有日期的分析師預估資料才能測，數學閘門通過前不改上線選股
formulas: FEG(i,t) ← consensus forecast EPS for next fiscal year ÷ latest actual EPS − 1 (only when actual EPS > 0; from a public, dated consensus source — never inferred)
FEG_rev(i,t) ← FEG(i,t) − FEG(i,t−1 month); up-revision if FEG_rev > 0, down-revision if < 0
excess return (paper's measure): r(i, next month) − r(TAIEX, next month); paper reports ≈ +2.11%/month for up-revision portfolios and ≈ +2.81%/month long-short
candidate screen (site proposal): among TW names already passing the live trend/volume rules, flag those with FEG_rev > 0 published in the last 20 trading days
check: paper-book replay with vs without the flag after TW costs (0.1425% fee each side, 0.3% sell tax); report hit rate and count of trades
site use: TW screener candidate only; blocked until a public dated consensus-revision source is found; no live change until math gate passes
items.mathGateNote: Olympiad gold-gate passedGate=false — analyst growth-revision flag stays a TW screener candidate (also blocked on a public dated data source); never status=adopted until the gate passes and an after-cost replay is done.

zh-Hant: 分析師剛把一家公司的獲利成長預估往上調，這檔股票之後一個月平均會比大盤多漲
往上修還是往下修，比預估成長率本身高不高更可靠

Whether the forecast was revised up or down matters more reliably than how high the growth forecast is

items.title: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System

titleLocalized.en: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 回測和實盤在哪裡分道揚鑣：一套當日交易系統的六個缺陷
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 回测和实盘在哪里分道扬镳：一套日内交易系统的六个缺陷
titleLocalized.ja: バックテストと実運用が食い違う所：あるデイトレード・システムの6つの欠陥

items.summary: A short field report from running one intraday US stock system live and replaying each live day in the backtest. The two drifted apart in ways that never showed up in summary numbers. Six defects are described: a default data feed that carried only a small part of the real opening volume; history adjusted for dividends while live orders see unadjusted prices; data the live system downloaded that the backtest never had; a position-sizing step that broke a limit the live account enforces; UTC timestamps read as New York time; and settings that were switched on but never reached the order code. For each, the authors give the symptom, how big the error was, the cause, and the test that now guards it, and they end with a ten-point checklist. They make no claim the system is profitable. Takeaway for the site: not a return signal but a checklist for our own guards — it matches the missing-last-session-volume bug our math guard caught on 2026-10-19.

summaryLocalized.en: Running one intraday US equity system live and replaying each day in the backtest exposed six defects that summary stats never showed: thin default volume feeds, dividend-adjusted history vs unadjusted live prices, data only one side had, sizing that broke account limits, UTC read as New York time, and settings that never reached the order code. Ends with a ten-point checklist. Used by the site as a guard checklist, not a signal.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 作者把一套美股當日交易系統實際上線，並把每個實盤日拿回回測重跑對照，結果發現兩邊悄悄走偏，而且從總績效數字完全看不出來。六個缺陷：預設資料源只帶到一小部分真實開盤成交量；歷史價格有做除息調整、實盤下單看到的卻是未調整價格；實盤有下載、回測卻沒有的資料；部位大小算出來超過券商帳戶實際允許的上限；把 UTC 時間當成紐約時間；以及設定打開了卻沒有真正傳到下單程式。每個缺陷都寫出症狀、誤差多大、原因和現在用來擋住它的測試，最後附十點檢查清單。作者不宣稱系統會賺錢。本站不把它當選股訊號，而是當自家檢查機制的清單——它正好對應 2026-10-19 數學檢查抓到的「最後一天成交量缺值被補成 0」問題。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 作者把一套美股日内交易系统实际上线，并把每个实盘日拿回回测重跑对照，结果发现两边悄悄走偏，而且从总绩效数字完全看不出来。六个缺陷：默认数据源只带到一小部分真实开盘成交量；历史价格做了除息调整、实盘下单看到的却是未调整价格；实盘有下载、回测却没有的数据；仓位大小算出来超过券商账户实际允许的上限；把 UTC 时间当成纽约时间；以及设定打开了却没有真正传到下单程序。每个缺陷都写出症状、误差多大、原因和现在用来挡住它的测试，最后附十点检查清单。作者不宣称系统会赚钱。本站不把它当选股信号，而是当自家检查机制的清单——它正好对应 2026-10-19 数学检查抓到的“最后一天成交量缺值被补成 0”问题。
summaryLocalized.ja: 米国株のデイトレード・システムを実運用し、毎日をバックテストで再現したところ、集計値には現れない6つの食い違いが見つかった：出来高の一部しか含まないデータ、配当調整済み履歴と未調整の実価格、片方にしかないデータ、口座上限を超えるサイズ計算、UTCをNY時間と誤読、注文コードに届かない設定。10項目のチェックリスト付き。本サイトはシグナルではなく検証チェックリストとして使う。

plainTakeaways: 回測漂亮不代表實盤一樣：兩邊的資料、時間、設定只要有一點不同，結果就會悄悄走偏
總績效數字看不出這些錯，要把每一天的實盤和回測逐筆對照才抓得到
常見陷阱：成交量資料不完整、除息調整價和實際成交價混用、時區搞錯、設定沒有真的生效
本站拿它當自家檢查清單（例如最後一天成交量缺值不能補成 0），不是選股訊號
formulas: daily parity check: for each paper-book day d, diff(d) ← |live fill or published close − replayed price for d|; flag if diff(d) > 0.5% of price
volume completeness: last-session volume missing or 0 while price moved → treat as missing (null), never zero-fill (already enforced by math-core observedVolume)
price basis: compute returns on adjusted closes, but compare fills and P&L against unadjusted closes; never mix the two in one formula
time basis: convert every source timestamp to its exchange zone (America/New_York for US, Asia/Taipei for TW) before picking the session date
config reach: every enabled strategy flag must appear in the published scan output; a flag that is on but absent fails the smoke test
site use: guard/test checklist candidate only; no change to live screener math
items.mathGateNote: Olympiad gold-gate passedGate=false — this is a verification checklist, not a return signal; any new guard derived from it is added as a test only and never alters live screener math.

本站拿它當自家檢查清單（例如最後一天成交量缺值不能補成 0），不是選股訊號
zh-Hans: 回测漂亮不代表实盘一样：两边的数据、时间、设定只要有一点不同，结果就会悄悄走偏
总绩效数字看不出这些错，要把每一天的实盘和回测逐笔对照才抓得到
常见陷阱：成交量数据不完整、除息调整价和实际成交价混用、时区搞错、设定没有真的生效
本站拿它当自家检查清单（例如最后一天成交量缺值不能补成 0），不是选股信号
en: A good backtest does not mean live trading will match: small differences in data, time or settings quietly pull them apart
Summary performance numbers hide these errors; you only catch them by comparing live and backtest day by day
Common traps: incomplete volume data, mixing dividend-adjusted and real prices, wrong time zones, settings that never take effect
The site uses it as a checklist for its own guards (e.g. a missing last-day volume must never become 0), not as a stock signal
ja: バックテストが良くても実運用が同じになるとは限らない：データ・時刻・設定のわずかな違いで静かにずれる
集計値ではこの誤りは見えず、日ごとに実運用とバックテストを突き合わせて初めて分かる
よくある落とし穴：出来高データの欠け、配当調整価格と実価格の混用、タイムゾーンの誤り、効いていない設定
本サイトは自前の検証チェックリストとして使う（最終日の出来高欠損を0にしない等）。銘柄シグナルではない

items.title: Asset pricing and a tale of night and day: Evidence from Taiwan

titleLocalized.en: Asset pricing and a tale of night and day: Evidence from Taiwan
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 白天與夜晚的資產定價：台股證據
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 白天与夜晚的资产定价：台股证据
titleLocalized.ja: 夜と昼の資産価格形成：台湾株の実証

items.summary: Splits each Taiwan stock's daily return into two parts: the overnight part (yesterday's close to today's open) and the daytime part (today's open to today's close). Earlier US work found that riskier, high-beta stocks earn more overnight and then lose it during the trading day; this paper tests the same idea in Taiwan, where retail investors do most of the trading and nothing trades overnight. The pattern holds strongly in Taiwan: higher market risk is rewarded overnight and penalised during the day. The authors' explanation is that daytime traders overreact and push prices back too far. They also find that cheap (value), profitable and low-investment stocks earn their extra return mainly overnight, while the small-company effect shows up mainly during the day. The abstract gives no trading-cost-adjusted strategy returns. Takeaway for the site: not a buy signal by itself, but a reminder that when a TW pick is bought (at the open or at the close) changes which half of the return it collects; worth measuring in the paper book before any rule change.

summaryLocalized.en: In Taiwan, high-beta (more market-sensitive) stocks earn more overnight (close to next open) and give it back during the trading day (open to close), likely because daytime traders overcorrect. Value, profitability and investment effects are earned overnight, the small-cap effect during the day. Watch item: the site should measure whether TW picks' returns come overnight or intraday before changing entry timing.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 把台股每天的報酬拆成兩段：「夜盤」那段（昨天收盤到今天開盤）和「日盤」那段（今天開盤到今天收盤）。美國先前的研究發現，對大盤比較敏感（高 beta）的股票，報酬多半是在夜裡賺到，白天交易時又吐回去；這篇用台股來檢驗，台股散戶交易比重高、晚上又不能交易，正好適合測。結果在台股非常明顯：承擔較多大盤風險的股票，夜裡有額外報酬、白天反而被扣分。作者認為原因是白天的交易者反應過度，把價格修正過頭。另外，便宜的價值股、獲利好的公司、少擴張投資的公司，額外報酬主要出現在夜裡；小型股效應則主要出現在白天。摘要沒有提供扣除交易成本後的策略報酬。本站不把它當買進訊號，而是提醒：台股選股是開盤買還是收盤買，會決定吃到哪一段報酬；要先在模擬帳本裡量清楚，才考慮改規則。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 把台股每天的报酬拆成两段：“夜盘”那段（昨天收盘到今天开盘）和“日盘”那段（今天开盘到今天收盘）。美国先前的研究发现，对大盘比较敏感（高 beta）的股票，报酬多半是在夜里赚到，白天交易时又吐回去；这篇用台股来检验，台股散户交易比重高、晚上又不能交易，正好适合测。结果在台股非常明显：承担较多大盘风险的股票，夜里有额外报酬、白天反而被扣分。作者认为原因是白天的交易者反应过度，把价格修正过头。另外，便宜的价值股、获利好的公司、少扩张投资的公司，额外报酬主要出现在夜里；小型股效应则主要出现在白天。摘要没有提供扣除交易成本后的策略报酬。本站不把它当买进信号，而是提醒：台股选股是开盘买还是收盘买，会决定吃到哪一段报酬；要先在模拟账本里量清楚，才考虑改规则。
summaryLocalized.ja: 台湾株では、市場感応度（ベータ）の高い銘柄は夜間（終値→翌始値）にリターンを稼ぎ、日中（始値→終値）に吐き出す。日中の売買が行き過ぎた修正をするためと考えられる。バリュー・収益性・投資の効果は夜間、小型株効果は日中に現れる。本サイトは監視項目とし、台湾株ピックのリターンが夜間か日中かをまず計測する。

plainTakeaways: 台股一天的漲跌可以拆成兩段：收盤到隔天開盤（夜裡），和開盤到收盤（白天）
對大盤比較敏感的股票，常常夜裡漲、白天又跌回去——白天的人容易修正過頭
價值股、獲利好的公司多半在夜裡賺到額外報酬；小型股效應則多出現在白天
本站只當觀察項目：先量台股選股的報酬是夜裡還是白天賺到的，數學閘門通過前不改買進時點
formulas: overnight return r_on(i,d) ← open(i,d) ÷ close(i,d−1) − 1 (use the same adjusted basis for both prices; skip day if either is missing)
daytime return r_day(i,d) ← close(i,d) ÷ open(i,d) − 1
check: (1 + r_on) × (1 + r_day) − 1 must equal the close-to-close return within 1e−9 (guard against mixed adjusted/unadjusted prices)
site measurement: for each published TW pick, sum overnight and daytime parts over its holding period; report the share of the total move earned overnight
beta(i) ← slope of the stock's daily returns on TAIEX daily returns over the past 250 trading days (null if fewer than 120 valid days)
site use: watch item only — compare paper-book entry at open vs at close after TW costs (0.1425% fee each side, 0.3% sell tax); no change to live screener or entry timing until the math gate passes
items.mathGateNote: Olympiad gold-gate passedGate=false — overnight vs daytime split is a measurement/watch item for TW picks; never status=adopted and no entry-timing change until the gate passes and an after-cost paper-book comparison is done.

zh-Hans: 台股一天的涨跌可以拆成两段：收盘到隔天开盘（夜里），和开盘到收盘（白天）
对大盘比较敏感的股票，常常夜里涨、白天又跌回去——白天的人容易修正过头
价值股、获利好的公司多半在夜里赚到额外报酬；小型股效应则多出现在白天
本站只当观察项目：先量台股选股的报酬是夜里还是白天赚到的，数学闸门通过前不改买进时点
en: A Taiwan stock's daily move splits into two parts: close to next open (overnight) and open to close (daytime)
Market-sensitive stocks often rise overnight and fall back during the day — daytime traders tend to overcorrect
Value and profitable firms earn their extra return mostly overnight; the small-cap effect shows up mostly in the daytime
Watch item only: first measure whether TW picks earn overnight or intraday; no change to entry timing until the math gate passes
ja: 台湾株の1日の値動きは、終値→翌始値（夜間）と始値→終値（日中）の2つに分けられる
市場に敏感な銘柄は夜間に上がり日中に戻しやすい——日中の売買が修正しすぎる
バリュー・高収益企業の超過リターンは主に夜間、小型株効果は主に日中に現れる
監視項目のみ：まず台湾株ピックが夜間と日中のどちらで稼ぐかを計測。数学ゲート通過前は買い時点を変えない

items.title: The Buffett Effect

titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 巴菲特效應：知名投資人公開持股後的股價反應
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 巴菲特效应：知名投资人公开持股后的股价反应
titleLocalized.ja: バフェット効果：著名投資家の保有開示と株価反応

items.summary: Asks whether a stock moves more when a famous investor reveals a new position in a quarterly 13F filing than when an equally sized but unknown fund does the same. The authors rank 24 well-known concentrated US stock-pickers by Wikipedia page views and news mentions, pair each with a similar little-known fund, and study 2000–2025. Only the five most famous managers (Buffett, Icahn, Burry, Ackman, Peltz) show a clear effect: their newly disclosed buys beat the control funds' buys by roughly 1.4% over the filing day and the next, and about 2.3% over five trading days, with no reversal over the following month; Icahn alone shows none. A portfolio that copies the five famous managers' new buys for a month earned an extra return that fades over about six months; waiting one more day to buy keeps roughly half of the one-month effect. Sales disclosures earn nothing. The effect is biggest in small, thinly traded stocks, results are before trading costs, and the authors say the copy portfolio is probably not a practical trading rule. Takeaway for the site: a watch item that links to our Buffett shelf — a 'famous-investor new 13F buy' flag is possible from public SEC filing dates, but the sample is five managers and the US SEC data path must work first.

summaryLocalized.en: Using 24 famous concentrated US stock-pickers vs 24 matched unknown funds (2000–2025), only the five most famous (Buffett, Icahn, Burry, Ackman, Peltz) move prices: their new 13F buys beat controls by about 1.4% over two days and 2.3% over five, without reversal; copying them for a month earned an extra return that fades within about six months. Before costs, strongest in small illiquid stocks, small sample. Watch item for a 'famous-investor new 13F buy' flag.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究問的是：同樣在每季 13F 申報裡揭露「新買進」一檔股票，知名投資人和沒沒無聞的基金相比，股價反應是不是比較大？作者用維基百科瀏覽量和新聞提及次數，替 24 位知名、持股集中的美國選股型經理人排名，每位再配一個規模和作風相近、但沒人認識的基金當對照，資料期間 2000–2025 年。結果只有最有名的五位（巴菲特、伊坎、貝瑞、艾克曼、佩爾茲）效果明顯：他們新揭露的買進，在申報當天加隔天比對照組多漲約 1.4%，五個交易日約多 2.3%，之後一個月也沒有跌回去；五人裡只有伊坎看不到效果。照抄這五人新買進、抱一個月的組合有額外報酬，大約半年內逐漸消失；如果晚一天才買，一個月的效果大約剩一半。賣出的揭露則沒有效果。效果在小型、成交量少的股票最大，數字都還沒扣交易成本，作者自己也說照抄組合不太算能實際操作的交易規則。本站把它列為觀察項目，正好連到巴菲特書架：可以用 SEC 公開申報日期做「知名投資人 13F 新買進」標記，但樣本只有五位，而且要先讓美股 SEC 資料來源穩定可用。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究问的是：同样在每季 13F 申报里披露“新买进”一只股票，知名投资人和默默无闻的基金相比，股价反应是不是比较大？作者用维基百科浏览量和新闻提及次数，替 24 位知名、持股集中的美国选股型经理人排名，每位再配一个规模和作风相近、但没人认识的基金当对照，数据期间 2000–2025 年。结果只有最有名的五位（巴菲特、伊坎、贝瑞、艾克曼、佩尔茨）效果明显：他们新披露的买进，在申报当天加隔天比对照组多涨约 1.4%，五个交易日约多 2.3%，之后一个月也没有跌回去；五人里只有伊坎看不到效果。照抄这五人新买进、持有一个月的组合有额外报酬，大约半年内逐渐消失；如果晚一天才买，一个月的效果大约剩一半。卖出的披露则没有效果。效果在小型、成交量少的股票最大，数字都还没扣交易成本，作者自己也说照抄组合不太算能实际操作的交易规则。本站把它列为观察项目，正好连到巴菲特书架：可以用 SEC 公开申报日期做“知名投资人 13F 新买进”标记，但样本只有五位，而且要先让美股 SEC 数据来源稳定可用。

Forward-looking signals can predict when small caps tend to win
In Taiwan the key is illiquidity, frequent price-limit hits and hard arbitrage, not slow news
Watch item only: can be tested later with public daily data; no live change until the math gate passes
ja: 台湾株の『小型株が勝つ』効果は平均では不安定で、単独では使えない

台湾では情報の遅れより、流動性の低さ・値幅制限到達・裁定の難しさが鍵

items.summary: Asks whether the 'small stocks beat big stocks' size premium in Taiwan, which on average looks unreliable, becomes predictable once you look at forward-looking signals, following Guo (2023), who used such signals to explain why the US size effect seemed to vanish after it was discovered. The authors find strong evidence that these signals do predict when the Taiwan size premium shows up. Unlike the US, information barriers (small firms being slower to absorb news) explain little in Taiwan; what matters more is how illiquid a stock is and how hard it is to arbitrage, measured by how often it hits the daily price limit. Takeaway for the site: a TW watch item — 'small cap' is not a reliable tilt on its own; if ever used, it should be conditioned on illiquidity and limit-hit frequency, both of which we can compute from public TWSE/TPEx daily data.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究問的是：台股「小型股長期比大型股會漲」的規模效應，平均來看時有時無、證據不一致，但如果改看一些「事先就看得到的訊號」，能不能預測哪段時間小型股會贏？作者沿用 Guo（2023）的做法（美國的研究用這類訊號解釋規模效應為何被發現後就「消失」），發現在台灣這些訊號確實能有效預測規模溢酬何時出現。跟美國不同的是，「小公司消息傳得慢」這種資訊障礙在台灣影響不大；真正比較能解釋的是股票的流動性差不差，以及套利難不難——用「多常碰到漲跌停」來衡量。本站把它列為台股觀察項目：單純「買小型股」不是可靠的規則；如果要用，應該搭配成交流動性和漲跌停頻率一起看，這兩樣都能用證交所／櫃買中心的公開日資料算出來。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究问的是：台股“小型股长期比大型股会涨”的规模效应，平均来看时有时无、证据不一致，但如果改看一些“事先就看得到的信号”，能不能预测哪段时间小型股会赢？作者沿用 Guo（2023）的做法（美国的研究用这类信号解释规模效应为何被发现后就“消失”），发现在台湾这些信号确实能有效预测规模溢酬何时出现。跟美国不同的是，“小公司消息传得慢”这种信息障碍在台湾影响不大；真正比较能解释的是股票的流动性差不差，以及套利难不难——用“多常碰到涨跌停”来衡量。本站把它列为台股观察项目：单纯“买小型股”不是可靠的规则；如果要用，应该搭配成交流动性和涨跌停频率一起看，这两样都能用证交所／柜买中心的公开日数据算出来。
summaryLocalized.en: Taiwan's size premium is inconclusive on average, but forward-looking signals (following Guo 2023) strongly predict when it appears. Unlike the US, information barriers matter little; stock illiquidity and limits to arbitrage measured by price-limit-hit frequency explain the predictable size effect better. TW watch item: 'buy small caps' alone is unreliable; condition on illiquidity and limit-hit frequency from public TWSE/TPEx data.
summaryLocalized.ja: 台湾株の規模効果（小型株が大型株を上回る）は平均では不安定だが、Guo（2023）にならった先行シグナルで出現時期を強く予測できる。米国と違い情報障壁の影響は小さく、流動性の低さと値幅制限到達の頻度で測った裁定の難しさの方が説明力が高い。台湾株の監視項目：『小型株を買う』だけでは不十分で、流動性と値幅制限到達頻度で条件付けるべき。

en: If an AI news reader has seen future text, backtests get inflated; a model trained only on old text forecast just as well
The best setup on validation lost money in the real test at every frequency — picking the prettiest backtest is dangerous
Averaging many models was steadier, but after costs it still did not beat a price-only approach
Methods lesson: average models, keep an untouched test window, audit data for look-ahead; no live change until the math gate passes
ja: AIが未来の文章を学習済みだとバックテストは水増しされる。古い文章だけのモデルでも予測力は劣らなかった
検証期で最良の設定は本番の検証期間で全頻度とも損失——見栄えの良いバックテストを選ぶのは危険

items.summary: Tests whether news topics forecast returns of the 1,000 largest US stocks while avoiding hindsight: AI readers trained on recent text already 'know' what happened later. The authors use NoLBERT, a language model trained only on 1976–1995 text, and compare it with older and newer topic readers on about 1.26 million Nasdaq.com articles (2012–2024). Models are fit on 2013–2019, every choice is made on 2020–2021, and 2022–2024 is held out, with 10 bp trading costs. Main lessons: (1) the single setup with the best validation score lost money in the test period at every rebalancing frequency; (2) measuring a topic's attention against its last ~3 months (63 trading days) instead of the last week improved forecasts for every reader; (3) the old-text model forecast about as well as the best modern one; (4) an equal-weight average of all readers and models earned a monthly net Sharpe ratio of about 1.1, significant against zero before adjusting for the many tries, but not better than a price-only ensemble. They also found data traps that create fake predictability (wrong article bodies, a return file missing stocks about to leave the index). Takeaway for the site: mostly a methods lesson — prefer averaging over picking the single best backtest, and audit data for look-ahead.

summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究問的是：用新聞主題能不能預測美國前 1,000 大股票的報酬，同時避開「後見之明」——用近年文字訓練的 AI 其實早就「讀過」之後發生的事，回測會被灌水。作者改用只讀過 1976–1995 年文字的語言模型 NoLBERT，和其他新舊幾種「讀新聞」的方法比較，資料是 2012–2024 年約 126 萬篇 Nasdaq.com 新聞。2013–2019 年用來訓練、2020–2021 年用來做所有選擇、2022–2024 年完全保留當考試，並扣每筆 0.1% 交易成本。重點：一、在驗證期分數最高的那一組設定，到考試期每種換股頻率都賠錢；二、把「某主題最近被關注多少」改成跟過去約三個月（63 個交易日）比，而不是只跟上週比，每一種讀法的預測都變好；三、只讀舊文字的模型預測力跟最好的新模型差不多；四、把所有讀法和模型平均起來，每月換股扣成本後夏普值約 1.1，未考慮試了很多次之前算顯著，但沒有贏過只用價格的組合。作者也抓出會製造「假預測力」的資料陷阱（新聞內文配錯標題、報酬檔漏掉快被踢出名單的股票）。本站把它當方法課：寧可平均多個模型，也不要挑回測最好看的那一個，並且要檢查資料有沒有偷看未來。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究问的是：用新闻主题能不能预测美国前 1,000 大股票的报酬，同时避开“后见之明”——用近年文字训练的 AI 其实早就“读过”之后发生的事，回测会被灌水。作者改用只读过 1976–1995 年文字的语言模型 NoLBERT，和其他新旧几种“读新闻”的方法比较，数据是 2012–2024 年约 126 万篇 Nasdaq.com 新闻。2013–2019 年用来训练、2020–2021 年用来做所有选择、2022–2024 年完全保留当考试，并扣每笔 0.1% 交易成本。重点：一、在验证期分数最高的那一组设定，到考试期每种换股频率都赔钱；二、把“某主题最近被关注多少”改成跟过去约三个月（63 个交易日）比，而不是只跟上周比，每一种读法的预测都变好；三、只读旧文字的模型预测力跟最好的新模型差不多；四、把所有读法和模型平均起来，每月换股扣成本后夏普值约 1.1，未考虑试了很多次之前算显著，但没有赢过只用价格的组合。作者也抓出会制造“假预测力”的数据陷阱（新闻内文配错标题、报酬档漏掉快被踢出名单的股票）。本站把它当方法课：宁可平均多个模型，也不要挑回测最好看的那一个，并且要检查数据有没有偷看未来。
summaryLocalized.en: Point-in-time news topics (NoLBERT, trained only on 1976–1995 text) vs modern readers on ~1.26M articles, forecasting the 1,000 largest US stocks; fit 2013–19, choose 2020–21, test 2022–24 net of 10 bp costs. The best-validation setup lost money at every frequency; a 63-day attention window beat a 5-day one for every reader; an equal-weight combination earned a monthly net Sharpe of ~1.1 but did not beat a price-only ensemble. Methods lesson: average rather than pick the best backtest, and audit data for look-ahead.
summaryLocalized.ja: 1976–1995年の文章だけで学習したNoLBERTのニュース話題と最新モデルを、約126万本の記事で比較し米国大型1,000銘柄を予測（2013–19学習、2020–21選択、2022–24検証、コスト10bp控除）。検証期で最良の設定は全頻度で損失、注目度を63日基準で測ると全モデルで改善、全モデル等加重平均は月次ネットSharpe約1.1だが価格のみの組合せに勝てず。方法論の教訓：最良バックテストを選ぶより平均し、先読みバイアスを点検する。
