items.title: Forecasting Taiwan Stock Return Using VIX and Volatility

titleLocalized.en: Forecasting Taiwan Stock Return Using VIX and Volatility
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 用 VIX 與波動度預測台股報酬
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 用 VIX 与波动度预测台股报酬
titleLocalized.ja: VIXとボラティリティで台湾株リターンを予測する

items.summary: Asks whether volatility measures and classic valuation ratios can forecast returns of the TAIEX and eight major Taiwan industry indices, using data from January 2007 to December 2025. Candidates are long-term adjusted volatility, short-term volatility, the VIX, idiosyncratic volatility, earnings-to-price, book-to-market and turnover. They fit simple one- and two-variable forecasting regressions both the ordinary way and with exponentially weighted least squares, which counts recent months more. Findings: short-term volatility explained TAIEX returns best inside the sample, while turnover mattered more for industry indices; out of sample, results differed a lot by industry, the best TAIEX forecaster combined long-term adjusted volatility with turnover, and the recency-weighted fit usually beat the ordinary one. Takeaway for the site: a TW watch item for a market-level risk dial (not a stock picker); everything it needs — index closes, turnover — is public TWSE data, but the gains are model- and sector-dependent.

summaryLocalized.en: Volatility measures (long-term adjusted, short-term, VIX, idiosyncratic) and valuation/turnover ratios tested as forecasters of TAIEX and eight TW industry indices, 2007–2025, with ordinary and recency-weighted (EWLS) regressions. Short-term volatility explained TAIEX best in-sample, turnover mattered more for industries; out of sample the best TAIEX combo was long-term adjusted volatility plus turnover, results varied widely by industry, and recency weighting usually won. Site use: watch item for a market-level risk dial, not a stock picker.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究問的是：各種「波動度」指標和傳統估值比率，能不能預測台灣加權指數和八個主要產業指數的報酬？資料從 2007 年 1 月到 2025 年 12 月。候選指標有長期調整波動度、短期波動度、VIX 恐慌指數、個股特有波動、本益比的倒數、淨值市價比和週轉率。作者用一般的迴歸，以及「越近的月份權重越大」的加權迴歸（EWLS）來比較。結果：在樣本內，短期波動度最能解釋加權指數報酬，產業指數則是週轉率比較重要；到了樣本外真正預測時，不同產業差很多，加權指數最好的組合是「長期調整波動度＋週轉率」，而且重視近期資料的加權方法通常比一般迴歸準。本站把它當台股觀察項目：適合做「大盤風險溫度計」，不是用來挑個股；需要的資料（指數收盤、週轉率）證交所都有公開，但效果會隨模型和產業改變。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究问的是：各种“波动度”指标和传统估值比率，能不能预测台湾加权指数和八个主要产业指数的报酬？数据从 2007 年 1 月到 2025 年 12 月。候选指标有长期调整波动度、短期波动度、VIX 恐慌指数、个股特有波动、市盈率的倒数、净值市价比和周转率。作者用一般的回归，以及“越近的月份权重越大”的加权回归（EWLS）来比较。结果：在样本内，短期波动度最能解释加权指数报酬，产业指数则是周转率比较重要；到了样本外真正预测时，不同产业差很多，加权指数最好的组合是“长期调整波动度＋周转率”，而且重视近期数据的加权方法通常比一般回归准。本站把它当台股观察项目：适合做“大盘风险温度计”，不是用来挑个股；需要的数据（指数收盘、周转率）证交所都有公开，但效果会随模型和产业改变。
summaryLocalized.ja: 長期調整ボラティリティ、短期ボラティリティ、VIX、固有ボラティリティと、益回り・簿価時価比率・回転率で、加権指数と台湾の主要8業種指数のリターンを予測できるかを検証（2007–2025年、通常回帰と直近重視のEWLS）。標本内では短期ボラティリティが加権指数を最もよく説明し、業種では回転率が重要。標本外では加権指数の最良は長期調整ボラティリティ＋回転率、業種差が大きく、EWLSが概ね優位。本サイトでは個別株選定ではなく市場リスク計としての観察項目。

plainTakeaways: 最近波動大不大，最能解釋台灣加權指數的漲跌（在過去資料裡）
真的拿來預測未來時，「長期波動＋成交週轉率」對大盤最好，但各產業差很多
讓越近的資料權重越大，預測通常比較準
本站只當大盤風險溫度計的觀察項目；數學閘門通過前不改上線選股

真的拿来预测未来时，“长期波动＋成交周转率”对大盘最好，但各产业差很多

en: Recent short-term volatility explained TAIEX moves best in past data
For true forecasting, long-term volatility plus turnover worked best for the index, but industries differed a lot
Weighting recent data more usually forecast better
Site use: market risk-dial watch item only; no live screener change until the math gate passes
ja: 過去データでは直近の短期ボラティリティが加権指数の動きを最もよく説明
実際の予測では長期ボラティリティ＋回転率が指数に最良だが、業種差が大きい
直近データを重く扱うと予測は概ね改善
本サイトでは市場リスク計の観察項目のみ。数学ゲート通過前はライブ選定を変えない

formulas: SV ← standard deviation of daily TAIEX returns over a short recent window (window length per paper, not yet replicated)
TURN ← market traded value ÷ market capitalization over the month (public TWSE data)
forecast: next-month index return = a + b·LVadj + c·TURN, fit only on data before the forecast month
EWLS ← least squares where an observation k months old gets weight λ^k (0<λ<1); compare with plain OLS out of sample
score: out-of-sample R² versus the historical-average forecast; positive means it beat the simple average
site use: watch item for a TAIEX risk dial only; no change to live TW picks until the math gate passes

items.title: Regime-Aware Interpretable Ranking for Sector Rotation

titleLocalized.en: Regime-Aware Interpretable Ranking for Sector Rotation
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 看景氣階段的可解釋類股輪動排名
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 看景气阶段的可解释板块轮动排名
titleLocalized.ja: 景気局面を考慮した解釈可能なセクターローテーション順位付け

items.summary: Treats sector rotation — deciding which S&P 500 sectors to overweight or underweight versus the index — as a ranking problem, where the target is each sector's future risk-adjusted performance relative to the benchmark (a forward Sharpe ratio of the sector-minus-index return). Their model, RegimeRank, turns fundamental and technical signals into familiar shapes (levels, changes, trends), lets learned macro factors decide which signals matter in the current environment, and lets sectors influence each other. Tested on weekly S&P 500 data from 2002 to 2024 with purged cross-validation (training and test windows separated so information cannot leak), it ranked sectors better than standard ranking and machine-learning baselines, and removing the macro or cross-sector parts made it worse. Takeaway for the site: a US watch item — the idea of 'which signals work depends on the macro regime' and the leak-proof testing method are useful; the neural model itself is not something we would run live.

summaryLocalized.en: Sector rotation framed as ranking S&P 500 sectors by forward benchmark-relative Sharpe. RegimeRank encodes fundamental/technical signals as familiar temporal traits, conditions them on learned macro factors, and models cross-sector links; on weekly 2002–2024 data with purged cross-validation it beat ranking and ML baselines, and ablations showed the macro and cross-sector parts help. Site use: watch item — regime-dependent signals and leak-proof testing are the lessons; no live model.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究把「類股輪動」——決定標普 500 哪些類股要比大盤多買、哪些少買——當成排名問題，目標是每個類股未來相對大盤的「風險調整後表現」（類股減大盤報酬的未來夏普值）。作者的模型 RegimeRank 把基本面和技術面訊號整理成大家熟悉的樣子（水準、變化、趨勢），讓模型自己學到的總經因子決定「現在這個景氣環境下哪些訊號比較重要」，並讓類股之間互相參考。用 2002–2024 年每週的標普 500 資料、搭配「清除重疊」的交叉驗證（訓練和測試期隔開，避免偷看答案）來測試，排名效果贏過常見的排名法和機器學習方法；拿掉總經或類股互相影響的部分，表現就變差。本站把它當美股觀察項目：「哪些訊號有效要看景氣階段」和防洩漏的測試方法值得學，但這個神經網路模型本身不會上線使用。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究把“板块轮动”——决定标普 500 哪些板块要比大盘多买、哪些少买——当成排名问题，目标是每个板块未来相对大盘的“风险调整后表现”（板块减大盘报酬的未来夏普值）。作者的模型 RegimeRank 把基本面和技术面信号整理成大家熟悉的样子（水平、变化、趋势），让模型自己学到的宏观因子决定“现在这个景气环境下哪些信号比较重要”，并让板块之间互相参考。用 2002–2024 年每周的标普 500 数据、搭配“清除重叠”的交叉验证（训练和测试期隔开，避免偷看答案）来测试，排名效果赢过常见的排名法和机器学习方法；拿掉宏观或板块互相影响的部分，表现就变差。本站把它当美股观察项目：“哪些信号有效要看景气阶段”和防泄漏的测试方法值得学，但这个神经网络模型本身不会上线使用。
summaryLocalized.ja: セクターローテーション（S&P500のどのセクターを指数比でオーバー／アンダーウェイトするか）を、将来の指数比シャープレシオで順位付けする問題として定式化。RegimeRankはファンダメンタル・テクニカル信号を馴染みのある時系列特性に変換し、学習したマクロ因子で条件付け、セクター間の関係もモデル化。2002–2024年の週次データとパージ付き交差検証で既存の順位付け・機械学習手法を上回り、マクロ部分やセクター間部分を外すと悪化。本サイトでは観察項目：局面依存の信号と漏洩防止の検証法が教訓で、モデル自体は使わない。

The target is not 'who rose most' but 'who beat the index after risk'
Keep training and test windows separated so the model cannot peek

ja: 同じ信号でも景気局面で効き方が変わる。セクター選択の前に環境を確認

formulas: active return_t ← sector return_t − S&P 500 return_t (weekly)
target ← forward Sharpe of active return = mean(active return over next H weeks) ÷ stdev(active return over next H weeks)
rank sectors by predicted target; overweight top, underweight bottom
purged CV: drop training weeks whose H-week target window overlaps the test block (plus an embargo gap) before fitting
sanity baseline: rank by trailing 12-week active Sharpe; any model must beat it after costs
site use: methods watch item only; no sector-rotation signal in the live US screener until the math gate passes
items.mathGateNote: Olympiad gold-gate passedGate=false — attention-based sector ranking stays a US watch item (needs macro factor data and a neural model we cannot audit cell by cell; reported gains are ranking metrics, not after-cost returns); never status=adopted. Its purged cross-validation and forward-Sharpe target feed our backtest gate, not the live screener.

items.title: Optimal Trading Filters and the Value of Predictive Signals
items.summary: Asks how much a return forecast is actually worth once you must turn it into trades that cost money and push the price against you for a while afterwards. Using prediction-theory tools, the author shows the best trading rule splits into two steps: first form the best forecast, then pass it through a smoothing filter that trades toward a target position gradually instead of jumping to it. With no trading costs, two signals that predict equally well today are equally valuable; once costs exist, what counts is how much of the forecast survives after weighting by trading friction, so slow, persistent signals keep more value than fast, noisy ones, and for mean-reverting signals there is a best middle speed. Takeaway for the site: a candidate idea for both markets — do not chase every daily signal flip; move gradually toward the target and favor signals that last long enough to pay for the trading.

summaryLocalized.en: How much a forecast is worth after trading costs and lingering price impact. The optimal rule is: best forecast, then a smoothing filter that trades gradually toward a target position. Without costs, equally predictive signals are equally valuable; with costs, slow persistent signals keep more value than fast noisy ones, and mean-reverting signals have a best middle speed. Site use: candidate idea — trade gradually toward targets and prefer signals that last long enough to pay for trading.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究問的是：一個報酬預測，扣掉交易成本、加上自己下單把價格推走一陣子之後，到底還值多少。作者用預測理論證明，最好的交易規則可以拆成兩步：先做出最好的預測，再用一個「平滑濾網」慢慢往目標部位調整，而不是一次跳過去。如果交易不用成本，今天預測力一樣好的兩個訊號價值一樣；但一有成本，真正算數的是「扣掉摩擦後還剩多少預測力」，所以變化慢、能持續的訊號比變來變去的快訊號更值錢；對會均值回歸的訊號，存在一個不快不慢的最佳速度。本站把它當美台股共用的候選想法：不要每天跟著訊號翻來翻去，應該分批往目標靠近，並優先使用能撐夠久、付得起交易成本的訊號。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 研究问的是：一个报酬预测，扣掉交易成本、加上自己下单把价格推走一阵子之后，到底还值多少。作者用预测理论证明，最好的交易规则可以拆成两步：先做出最好的预测，再用一个“平滑滤网”慢慢往目标仓位调整，而不是一次跳过去。如果交易不用成本，今天预测力一样好的两个信号价值一样；但一有成本，真正算数的是“扣掉摩擦后还剩多少预测力”，所以变化慢、能持续的信号比变来变去的快信号更值钱；对会均值回归的信号，存在一个不快不慢的最佳速度。本站把它当美台股共用的候选想法：不要每天跟着信号翻来翻去，应该分批往目标靠近，并优先使用能撑够久、付得起交易成本的信号。

items.title: From Alpha to Execution: Trading Horizons, Regimes, and Schedules under Concave Impact and Hurst Scaling
items.summary: Studies how fast a large order should be worked when market impact grows less than proportionally with size and prices wander with a measurable persistence. The authors pick the execution window that maximizes the trade's risk-adjusted profit: going slower cuts cost per share and price-path noise, while the only reason to hurry is alpha that disappears while you wait. A sensible middle speed exists only when both forces point the right way; otherwise trade as fast or as slow as allowed, and the best window is very flat, so precision matters little. Given the window, their front-loaded schedule that tapers off saves about 10–17% of modeled cost versus trading evenly over time. Takeaway for the site: deferred — this matters for institutional-size US orders, not the small paper-book fills our site simulates.

summaryLocalized.en: How fast to work a large order under concave impact and persistent price moves. Choose the window that maximizes the trade's Sharpe: slower lowers cost and noise, urgency comes only from decaying alpha. An interior speed exists only when both forces align, and the optimum is flat. A front-loaded, tapering schedule saves ~10–17% of modeled cost vs. even (TWAP) trading. Site use: deferred — relevant to institutional-size orders, not our small simulated fills.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 研究大單該下多快：當下單對價格的衝擊不會跟單量成正比放大、而且價格走勢帶有一定的延續性時，怎麼安排。作者挑出讓這筆交易「風險調整後獲利」最高的執行時間：下慢一點，每股成本和價格亂跳的風險都會變小；唯一要趕快的理由，是等待中會慢慢消失的超額報酬。只有兩股力量方向都對時才有「不快不慢」的最佳速度，否則就是能多快就多快、或能多慢就多慢；而且最佳時間附近很平，算得差一點也沒關係。時間決定後，他們的「前面多下、後面漸少」排程，比整段平均下單省下約 10–17% 的模型成本。本站暫緩：這對機構級的美股大單才重要，我們模擬帳本的小額成交用不到。

summaryLocalized.ja: 大口注文をどの速さで執行すべきかを、インパクトが数量に比例せず緩やかに増え、価格に持続性がある前提で分析。取引のシャープレシオを最大化する執行期間を選ぶ：遅くすると1株あたりコストと価格変動リスクが下がり、急ぐ理由は待つ間に消えるアルファだけ。両方の力が揃う時だけ中間の最適速度があり、最適付近は平坦。期間が決まれば、前半に多く後半に減らすスケジュールが均等執行（TWAP）よりモデル上のコストを約10–17%削減。本サイトでは保留：機関投資家規模の注文向けで、当サイトの小口模擬約定には不要。

items.title: Directionally Correct Views in Portfolio Optimization
items.summary: Portfolio models usually lean on past data, which may not match what the next months bring. Borrowing the Black-Litterman idea of blending in outside opinions, the authors ask whether adding views that only get the direction right (this asset will beat that one, without a precise number) improves allocation. In a basic mean-variance setup they show even a little correct directional information noticeably improves decisions, and they sketch an entropy-based way to put such views into end-to-end learned portfolio models. In their tests, a plain mean-variance model with correct directional views did about as well as the fancier end-to-end model. Takeaway for the site: a watch item for both markets — a simple 'tilt toward the side you have a reasoned view on' can matter more than model complexity, but only if the views are actually right, which we cannot assume.

summaryLocalized.en: Can views that only get the direction right improve portfolio allocation? In a basic mean-variance setup, even a little correct directional information helps materially; an entropy-based method brings such views into end-to-end models. Empirically, simple mean-variance with correct views matched the end-to-end model. Site use: watch — simple directional tilts can beat model complexity, but only when the views are right.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 投資組合模型通常靠過去資料估參數，但過去不一定像接下來幾個月。作者借用 Black-Litterman「把專家看法混進模型」的想法，問：如果只加入「方向對」的看法（例如 A 會比 B 強，但不給精確數字），配置會不會變好？在最基本的平均數－變異數模型裡，他們證明只要一點點方向正確的資訊，就能明顯改善決策；也提出用「熵」的概念把這類看法放進端到端學習模型。實測結果有點意外：加入方向正確的看法後，簡單模型和複雜模型表現差不多。本站列為觀察：有根據的「方向傾斜」可能比模型複雜度更重要，但前提是看法真的對，這點不能先假設。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 投资组合模型通常靠过去数据估参数，但过去不一定像接下来几个月。作者借用 Black-Litterman“把专家看法混进模型”的想法，问：如果只加入“方向对”的看法（例如 A 会比 B 强，但不给精确数字），配置会不会变好？在最基本的均值－方差模型里，他们证明只要一点点方向正确的信息，就能明显改善决策；也提出用“熵”的概念把这类看法放进端到端学习模型。实测结果有点意外：加入方向正确的看法后，简单模型和复杂模型表现差不多。本站列为观察：有根据的“方向倾斜”可能比模型复杂度更重要，但前提是看法真的对，这点不能先假设。
summaryLocalized.ja: 過去データに頼るポートフォリオ最適化に、方向だけ正しい見通し（AがBに勝つ等）を加えると配分は改善するかを検討。基本的な平均分散モデルでは、わずかな方向的に正しい情報でも意思決定が大きく改善。エントロピーに基づきエンドツーエンドモデルへ組み込む方法も提示。実証では、正しい見通しを入れると単純なモデルが複雑なモデルと同等。本サイトでは観察：根拠ある方向の傾けはモデルの複雑さより効くことがあるが、見通しが正しい前提。

items.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
items.summary: News can move prices after it comes out, but old news is probably already in the price. Using a fixed language model to pull signals out of public SEC filings, the authors compare two ways to handle aging news: keep it and tell the portfolio policy how old it is, or throw old items away before choosing a portfolio. They test reinforcement-learning policies and a language model that picks portfolios directly, scoring returns after trading costs over 2023–2025. Telling the learning policy the news age changed its behaviour in a controlled test but did not reliably help historical returns; for the language model, simply filtering out stale news gave the best average net return, about 18.4% a year in their setup with a four-week delivery delay, ahead of every learning strategy that used news. Takeaway for the site: a candidate idea for US event data — when a news or filing item is stale, drop it rather than try to weight it cleverly.

summaryLocalized.en: How to treat aging news signals extracted by an LLM from SEC filings: keep them with timing info, or filter old ones out. Over 2023–2025, net of costs, timing info did not reliably help RL policies; for an LLM picking portfolios, filtering stale news gave the best average net return (~18.4%/yr in their four-week-delay setup), beating all news-using RL strategies. Site use: candidate — drop stale news/filing items rather than weight them cleverly.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 新聞發布後還可能影響股價，但舊新聞多半已經反映在價格裡。作者用一個固定的語言模型，從美國證管會（SEC）的公開申報文件抽出訊號，比較兩種處理「變舊新聞」的方法：保留它並告訴投資策略它有多舊，或是在選股前直接把舊的丟掉。他們測試強化學習策略，以及直接讓語言模型挑投資組合，用 2023–2025 年扣掉交易成本後的報酬來比。結果：告訴強化學習「新聞幾歲了」在控制實驗裡會改變行為，但歷史報酬沒有穩定變好；對語言模型來說，直接濾掉舊新聞的平均淨報酬最高，在他們「新聞晚四週才到」的設定下約每年 18.4%，勝過所有用新聞的強化學習策略。本站列為美股候選想法：新聞或申報資料過期了就直接不用，不要想辦法巧妙加權。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 新闻发布后还可能影响股价，但旧新闻多半已经反映在价格里。作者用一个固定的语言模型，从美国证监会（SEC）的公开申报文件抽出信号，比较两种处理“变旧新闻”的方法：保留它并告诉投资策略它有多旧，或是在选股前直接把旧的丢掉。他们测试强化学习策略，以及直接让语言模型挑投资组合，用 2023–2025 年扣掉交易成本后的报酬来比。结果：告诉强化学习“新闻几岁了”在控制实验里会改变行为，但历史报酬没有稳定变好；对语言模型来说，直接滤掉旧新闻的平均净报酬最高，在他们“新闻晚四周才到”的设定下约每年 18.4%，胜过所有用新闻的强化学习策略。本站列为美股候选想法：新闻或申报数据过期了就直接不用，不要想办法巧妙加权。

items.title: Jawboning the Fed: Do Markets Listen When Administrations Talk?
items.summary: When the White House or other officials publicly lean on the Federal Reserve, do markets care? The authors had a group of open language models sort about 37 years of Reuters stories (1988–2025) into pressure for lower rates or pressure for higher rates, then looked at how markets moved the same day. Pressure for lower rates nudged near-term rate expectations down by about one basis point per event — roughly a 4% bump in the odds of a cut at the next Fed meeting — and the effect faded steadily, gone after about three months. The dollar weakened a bit, while inflation expectations and volatility barely moved. Pressure for higher rates had no visible effect, and the result holds even without the Trump years. Takeaway for the site: a watch item for the US macro calendar — political talk about the Fed is a small, short-lived rate signal, not a reason to change stock picks.

summaryLocalized.en: Uses an LLM ensemble on Reuters stories 1988–2025 to tag political pressure on the Fed as dovish or hawkish. Dovish pressure lowers near-term rate expectations ~1bp per event (~4% higher odds of a cut at the next FOMC), fading to zero beyond ~3 months, with a weaker dollar and flat inflation compensation and volatility; hawkish pressure has no detectable effect; holds excluding Trump terms. Site use: watch — a small, short-lived macro signal, not a stock-pick input.

items.title: How do standard time series forecasting benchmarks translate to finance? A broad study of risk adjusted performance
items.summary: Many fancy forecasting models top general time-series leaderboards; this study checks whether that carries over to trading. The authors trained 16 deep-learning designs (Transformers, state-space models, xLSTM, recurrent hybrids and more) on 15 years of daily futures data, judging each by the risk-adjusted return of a volatility-targeted strategy built on its forecasts. Several popular 'state-of-the-art' models, including plain Transformers and state-space models, did worse than a simple one-step autoregressive baseline. The best results came from simpler recurrent hybrids: a variable-selection network feeding an LSTM had the highest Sharpe ratio, and xLSTM held up best when trading costs were added. Accepted in the Journal of Forecasting. Takeaway for the site: a watch item that backs our current approach — keep simple, checkable rules and always compare any new model against a dumb baseline after costs.

summaryLocalized.en: Benchmarks 16 deep-learning forecasters on 15 years of daily futures with a volatility-targeted Sharpe objective. Generic Transformers and SSMs underperformed a simple AR(1) baseline; a Variable Selection Network + LSTM had the best Sharpe and xLSTM was most robust to costs. Leaderboard wins don't reliably transfer to finance. Site use: watch — supports keeping simple rules and always beating a simple baseline net of costs.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 很多花俏的預測模型在一般時間序列排行榜上名列前茅，這篇研究檢查它們拿來交易是否一樣厲害。作者用 15 年的每日期貨資料，訓練 16 種深度學習模型（Transformer、狀態空間模型、xLSTM、循環網路混合型等），用「依預測做、並把波動控制在目標水準的策略」的風險調整後報酬來評分。結果好幾個熱門的「最先進」模型，包括一般 Transformer 和狀態空間模型，輸給最簡單的「只看前一天」自我迴歸基準。表現最好的是比較簡單的循環網路混合型：變數篩選網路接 LSTM 的夏普值最高，xLSTM 在加上交易成本後最穩。已被《Journal of Forecasting》接受。本站列為觀察：支持我們現在的做法——規則保持簡單、可檢查，新模型一定要先在扣成本後贏過笨基準。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 很多花哨的预测模型在一般时间序列排行榜上名列前茅，这篇研究检查它们拿来交易是否一样厉害。作者用 15 年的每日期货数据，训练 16 种深度学习模型（Transformer、状态空间模型、xLSTM、循环网络混合型等），用“依预测做、并把波动控制在目标水平的策略”的风险调整后报酬来评分。结果好几个热门的“最先进”模型，包括一般 Transformer 和状态空间模型，输给最简单的“只看前一天”自回归基准。表现最好的是比较简单的循环网络混合型：变量筛选网络接 LSTM 的夏普值最高，xLSTM 在加上交易成本后最稳。已被《Journal of Forecasting》接受。本站列为观察：支持我们现在的做法——规则保持简单、可检查，新模型一定要先在扣成本后赢过笨基准。
summaryLocalized.ja: 15年分の日次先物データで16種の深層学習予測モデルを、ボラティリティ目標型戦略のシャープレシオで比較。汎用Transformerや状態空間モデルは単純なAR(1)基準に負け、変数選択ネットワーク＋LSTMがシャープ最高、xLSTMが取引コストに最も強かった。一般ベンチマークの好成績は金融では通用しにくい。本サイトではウォッチ：単純で検証可能なルールを保ち、新モデルはコスト控除後に単純基準を上回ることを必須にする。

items.summary: Most portfolio research assumes shorting, leverage and frequent trading, which a regular saver cannot use. This study tests well-known portfolio methods under a private investor's real limits: a handful of liquid US ETFs, monthly rebalancing with trading costs, no shorting and no leverage, and every setting easy to explain. Without any return forecast, risk-only methods such as risk parity and minimum volatility (built on a statistical factor risk model) already work; with a forecast, the authors add momentum signals and a shrunk regression on top of the classic mean-variance setup. Portfolios of as few as three ETFs gave steady, decent returns over about twenty years without being tuned to the test period, and beat the standard 60/40 mix. The code is public. Takeaway for the site: a watch item for a future plain-language "long-term ETF allocation" panel, not a stock-picking signal.

summaryLocalized.en: Tests standard portfolio methods under private-investor limits (a few liquid US ETFs, monthly rebalancing with costs, no shorting or leverage, interpretable parameters). Risk-only methods (risk parity, minimum volatility on a factor risk model) and Markowitz plus momentum with ridge regression gave consistent, decent returns over ~20 years with as few as three ETFs, beating 60/40 without backtest tuning. Open-source code. Site use: watch — possible long-term ETF allocation panel, not a stock signal.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 大部分投資組合研究都假設可以放空、開槓桿、頻繁交易，一般存錢的人根本做不到。這篇研究改用散戶的真實限制來測試常見方法：只用幾檔流動性好的美國 ETF、每月調整一次並扣交易成本、不放空、不借錢，而且每個設定都講得清楚。完全不預測報酬時，只看風險的做法（風險平價、最低波動）就已經有效；有預測時，再把動能訊號加進傳統的「報酬對風險」配置。只要三檔 ETF 的組合，在大約二十年間就能穩定拿到不錯的報酬，沒有針對回測期間調參數，還贏過常見的股六債四。程式碼公開。本站列為觀察：未來可做成白話的「長期 ETF 配置」區塊，不是選股訊號。

titleLocalized.en: Weekend Crypto Volatility and Monday Market Risk
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 週末加密貨幣大波動，週一美股風險跟著變大？
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 周末加密货币大波动，周一美股风险跟着变大？
titleLocalized.ja: 週末の暗号資産ボラティリティと月曜の市場リスク

items.summary: Crypto trades all weekend while stock and bond markets are closed. This study asks whether a wild weekend in crypto warns of a bumpier Monday elsewhere. Using daily high-low price ranges for Bitcoin, Ether and XRP plus the S&P 500, gold and a US Treasury ETF from 2017 to 2026, the authors add one shared "weekend crypto swing" measure to a standard volatility forecasting model. Before 2024 it told you little; since then it matters: a one-standard-deviation jump in weekend crypto swings came with roughly 27–54% more expected Monday variance, and out-of-sample forecast errors fell 11–22%, though the evidence is stronger in some markets than others. Friday crypto swings do not do the same thing, and the change point lands in late 2023, around the run-up to US spot-Bitcoin ETFs; why it happens is still unclear. Takeaway for the site: a watch item for a possible Monday risk note, not a buy or sell rule.

summaryLocalized.en: Adds a common weekend crypto (BTC/ETH/XRP) range-based volatility factor to HAR models for Monday variance of the S&P 500, gold and a Treasury ETF, 2017–2026. Weak before 2024, significant after: +1 s.d. ≈ 27–54% higher fitted Monday variance, 11–22% lower out-of-sample QLIKE loss, with mixed significance by market. Friday crypto volatility does not replicate; break estimated late 2023 near spot-Bitcoin ETF anticipation; mechanism unresolved. Site use: watch — possible Monday risk note, not a trade rule.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 加密貨幣週末照常交易，股市債市卻休市。這篇研究問：週末幣圈震很大，週一其他市場會不會也比較顛簸？作者用 2017 到 2026 年比特幣、以太幣、XRP，以及標普 500、黃金、美國公債 ETF 每天的最高最低價差，在常見的波動預測模型裡加進一個共同的「週末幣圈震幅」指標。2024 年以前幾乎沒用；之後就有用了：週末幣圈震幅高出平常一個標準差，預估的週一波動大約多 27–54%，樣本外預測誤差少了 11–22%，不過各市場證據強弱不一。週五的幣圈震幅沒有同樣效果，轉折點大約在 2023 年底、市場期待美國比特幣現貨 ETF 的時候，原因還沒弄清楚。本站列為觀察：未來可當成「週一風險提醒」，不是買賣規則。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 加密货币周末照常交易，股市债市却休市。这篇研究问：周末币圈震很大，周一其他市场会不会也比较颠簸？作者用 2017 到 2026 年比特币、以太币、XRP，以及标普 500、黄金、美国国债 ETF 每天的最高最低价差，在常见的波动预测模型里加进一个共同的“周末币圈震幅”指标。2024 年以前几乎没用；之后就有用了：周末币圈震幅高出平常一个标准差，预估的周一波动大约多 27–54%，样本外预测误差少了 11–22%，不过各市场证据强弱不一。周五的币圈震幅没有同样效果，转折点大约在 2023 年底、市场期待美国比特币现货 ETF 的时候，原因还没弄清楚。本站列为观察：未来可当成“周一风险提醒”，不是买卖规则。
summaryLocalized.ja: 暗号資産は週末も取引されるが、株式・債券市場は休場。本研究は週末の暗号資産の大きな値動きが月曜の他市場の荒れを予告するかを検証。2017〜2026年のBTC・ETH・XRPとS&P500・金・米国債ETFの日次高安レンジを使い、一般的なボラティリティ予測モデルに共通の「週末暗号資産ボラ」要因を追加。2024年以前はほぼ効果なし、以降は1標準偏差の上昇で月曜の予測分散が約27〜54%増え、サンプル外の予測誤差は11〜22%減少（市場により証拠の強さは異なる）。金曜のボラでは再現せず、構造変化は2023年末の現物ビットコインETF期待の時期で、仕組みは未解明。本サイトはウォッチ：月曜リスク注記の候補で売買ルールではない。

plainTakeaways: 週末幣圈震很大，週一美股波動常常也變大（2024 年起才明顯）
週末震幅高一個標準差，週一預估波動多約 27–54%
週五的幣圈波動沒有這個效果，原因還不清楚
本站觀察：可當週一風險提醒，不是買賣訊號

en: Big weekend crypto swings now often mean a bumpier Monday for US stocks (clear only since 2024)
One standard deviation more weekend swing ≈ 27–54% more expected Monday variance
Friday crypto swings don't do this, and the reason is still unclear
Site use: watch — a Monday risk note, not a trade signal

周末震幅高一个标准差，周一预估波动多约 27–54%
周五的币圈波动没有这个效果，原因还不清楚
本站观察：可当周一风险提醒，不是买卖信号
ja: 週末の暗号資産の大きな値動きは月曜の米株の荒れにつながりやすい（2024年以降）
週末ボラが1標準偏差高いと月曜の予測分散は約27〜54%増

formulas: daily range variance (Parkinson): RV_t = (ln H_t − ln L_t)² / (4 ln 2)
weekend crypto factor W = first principal component (or average of z-scores) of Sat+Sun range variance for BTC, ETH, XRP
HAR model: RV_Mon = β0 + βd RV_Fri + βw RV_week + βm RV_month + γ × W + ε
forecast loss QLIKE = RV / RV̂ − ln(RV / RV̂) − 1 (lower is better)
site use: watch only — no screener change while the math gate is not passed

items.title: Do Round Numbers Hold Prices? Occupation Densities and Depth-Conditioned Hazards in the Limit Order Book

titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 整數關卡真的撐得住股價嗎？
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 整数关卡真的撑得住股价吗？
titleLocalized.ja: キリの良い価格は株価を支えるのか？

items.summary: Stock prices spend extra time at round numbers like $20.00, and traders often read that as a support or resistance wall. This study checks a simpler explanation: more buy and sell orders simply pile up at round prices, and a thicker queue takes longer to clear. Using full order-book data for five Nasdaq stocks through 2025, the authors find round prices do attract more resting orders, but once you account for how deep the queue is, prices do not linger there any longer than at other prices. Two stocks (Intel and SoFi) showed prices tending to move away from round levels. Takeaway for the site: treat 'round-number support' as mostly a crowd-of-orders effect, not a rule to buy or sell on.

summaryLocalized.en: Round-number price clustering vs. a mechanical depth explanation. Tick-grid local-time framework on 2025 order-book data for 5 Nasdaq stocks: round levels hold more liquidity but show no longer depth-adjusted durations; INTC and SOFI show departures biased away from round levels. Site use: watch — a caution against round-number 'support' rules, not a signal.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 股價常在 20.00 這種整數價位停比較久，很多人把它當成支撐或壓力。這篇研究檢查一個更簡單的解釋：整數價位本來就掛比較多買賣單，排隊的單越多，價格要走過去就越久。作者用 2025 年五檔那斯達克股票的完整委託簿資料發現：整數價位確實掛單比較多，但把掛單厚度考慮進去後，價格在整數價位並沒有停得比較久。英特爾和 SoFi 兩檔反而有價格傾向離開整數價位的現象。本站列為觀察：「整數關卡支撐」大多只是掛單擠在那裡，不是買賣規則。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 股价常在 20.00 这种整数价位停比较久，很多人把它当成支撑或压力。这篇研究检查一个更简单的解释：整数价位本来就挂比较多买卖单，排队的单越多，价格要走过去就越久。作者用 2025 年五档纳斯达克股票的完整委托簿数据发现：整数价位确实挂单比较多，但把挂单厚度考虑进去后，价格在整数价位并没有停得比较久。英特尔和 SoFi 两档反而有价格倾向离开整数价位的现象。本站列为观察：“整数关卡支撑”大多只是挂单挤在那里，不是买卖规则。
summaryLocalized.ja: 株価は20.00ドルのようなキリの良い価格に長く留まりがちで、支持線・抵抗線と解釈されることが多い。本研究は、そこに注文が多く積まれ厚い待ち行列ほど抜けるのに時間がかかるという単純な説明を検証。2025年のナスダック5銘柄の板データでは、キリの良い価格には注文が多く集まるが、板の厚さを考慮すると滞在時間は長くない。インテルとSoFiでは逆にキリ番から離れる傾向も。本サイトはウォッチ：キリ番の支持は主に注文の集中で、売買ルールではない。

plainTakeaways: 整數價位掛單比較多，所以價格看起來「卡住」
把掛單厚度算進去後，整數價位並沒有特別撐得住
英特爾、SoFi 甚至傾向離開整數價位
本站觀察：別把整數關卡當買賣訊號

en: More orders rest at round prices, so prices look 'stuck' there
After adjusting for order depth, round prices don't hold any better
Intel and SoFi even tended to move away from round prices
Site use: watch — don't treat round numbers as a trade signal
zh-Hant: 整數價位掛單比較多，所以價格看起來「卡住」
把掛單厚度算進去後，整數價位並沒有特別撐得住
英特爾、SoFi 甚至傾向離開整數價位
本站觀察：別把整數關卡當買賣訊號
zh-Hans: 整数价位挂单比较多，所以价格看起来“卡住”
把挂单厚度算进去后，整数价位并没有特别撑得住
英特尔、SoFi 甚至倾向离开整数价位
本站观察：别把整数关卡当买卖信号

板の厚さを考慮するとキリ番が特に支えるわけではない

本サイトはウォッチ：キリ番を売買シグナルにしない

formulas: occupation density at price level k: L_k = number of departures from tick k over the sample
depth-adjusted hazard: departures_k / (time at k) compared across round vs non-round k after controlling for queue depth
round-level flag: k mod 100 cents == 0 (or mod 50 / mod 10)
site use: watch only — no screener change while the math gate is not passed

items.title: Market Regime-Based Multi-Asset Portfolio Optimization Using Nested Clustered Optimization for Tactical Asset Allocation

titleLocalized.en: Does Switching by Market Regime Help a Multi-Asset Portfolio?
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 依「多空盤勢」切換配置，真的比較好嗎？
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 依“多空盘势”切换配置，真的比较好吗？
titleLocalized.ja: 相場局面で配分を切り替えると本当に良くなるのか？

items.summary: Many systems try to detect whether the market is in a calm or stormy phase and change the portfolio accordingly. This study tests that idea on a small mix of Indonesian assets (government bonds, a stock index, gold, a currency and Bitcoin), monthly from January 2021 to August 2025, using a clustering-based way to spread money across assets. The plain version, with no phase detection, returned about 30% in total (about 5.8% a year) with a worst drop of only about 2.2% and little trading. Adding an automatic phase detector made it trade far more (47 rebalances, about a quarter of the portfolio each month), cut the total return to about 1.6% and deepened the worst drop to about 10%. Lesson: a phase switch that flips too easily can add noise and costs instead of protection. Takeaway for the site: a warning to keep our own market-regime dial slow and sticky, not a new rule.

summaryLocalized.en: Tests HMM regime conditioning of Nested Clustered Optimization on a monthly Indonesian multi-asset universe (bonds, LQ45, gold, CNY/IDR, BTC), Jan 2021–Aug 2025 walk-forward. Regime-agnostic NCO: ~29.97% cumulative (5.78%/yr), max drawdown 2.18%, turnover 5.41%/month. Unconstrained HMM-conditioned NCO: 47 rebalances, 24.58% monthly turnover, 1.60% cumulative, 9.99% drawdown. Without transition persistence, regime switching can hurt. Site use: watch — supports keeping regime changes sticky; no rule change.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 很多系統會先判斷現在是平穩盤還是動盪盤，再跟著換配置。這篇研究用一小組印尼資產（政府公債、股價指數、黃金、匯率、比特幣），從 2021 年 1 月到 2025 年 8 月每月測試，用一種「先分群再分配資金」的方法。不判斷盤勢的單純版本，總報酬約 30%（每年約 5.8%），最大跌幅只有約 2.2%，交易也很少。加上自動盤勢判斷後，交易暴增（換了 47 次，每月約四分之一的部位在換），總報酬掉到約 1.6%，最大跌幅加深到約 10%。結論：太容易切換的盤勢開關，帶來的是雜訊和成本，不是保護。本站列為觀察：提醒我們自己的多空盤勢判斷要慢、要穩，不新增規則。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 很多系统会先判断现在是平稳盘还是动荡盘，再跟着换配置。这篇研究用一小组印尼资产（政府国债、股价指数、黄金、汇率、比特币），从 2021 年 1 月到 2025 年 8 月每月测试，用一种“先分群再分配资金”的方法。不判断盘势的单纯版本，总报酬约 30%（每年约 5.8%），最大跌幅只有约 2.2%，交易也很少。加上自动盘势判断后，交易暴增（换了 47 次，每月约四分之一的部位在换），总报酬掉到约 1.6%，最大跌幅加深到约 10%。结论：太容易切换的盘势开关，带来的是杂讯和成本，不是保护。本站列为观察：提醒我们自己的多空盘势判断要慢、要稳，不新增规则。
summaryLocalized.ja: 多くのシステムは相場が平穏か荒れているかを判定して配分を変える。本研究はインドネシアの少数資産（国債、株価指数、金、為替、ビットコイン）で2021年1月〜2025年8月を月次で検証。局面判定なしの単純版は累計約30%（年約5.8%）、最大下落約2.2%で売買も少ない。自動の局面判定を加えると売買が急増（47回、毎月約4分の1を入替）、累計約1.6%に低下し最大下落は約10%に。切り替えやすすぎる局面判定はノイズとコストを増やす。本サイトはウォッチ：自サイトの相場局面判定はゆっくり安定させるべきという注意で、新ルールではない。

plainTakeaways: 不判斷盤勢的單純配置：約 30% 總報酬、最大跌幅約 2.2%
加上太敏感的盤勢開關：交易暴增，報酬掉到約 1.6%、跌幅約 10%
盤勢切換要有「黏性」，不然只是多付手續費
本站觀察：我們的多空判斷維持慢而穩，不改規則

en: Plain allocation without regime detection: ~30% total, worst drop ~2.2%
With a jumpy regime switch: far more trading, ~1.6% total, ~10% worst drop
Regime switches need stickiness, or they just add costs
Site use: watch — keep our regime dial slow and steady; no rule change
zh-Hant: 不判斷盤勢的單純配置：約 30% 總報酬、最大跌幅約 2.2%
加上太敏感的盤勢開關：交易暴增，報酬掉到約 1.6%、跌幅約 10%
盤勢切換要有「黏性」，不然只是多付手續費
本站觀察：我們的多空判斷維持慢而穩，不改規則
zh-Hans: 不判断盘势的单纯配置：约 30% 总报酬、最大跌幅约 2.2%
加上太敏感的盘势开关：交易暴增，报酬掉到约 1.6%、跌幅约 10%
盘势切换要有“黏性”，不然只是多付手续费
本站观察：我们的多空判断维持慢而稳，不改规则
ja: 局面判定なしの単純配分：累計約30%、最大下落約2.2%
敏感すぎる局面切替：売買急増、累計約1.6%、最大下落約10%

本サイトはウォッチ：相場局面判定はゆっくり安定、ルール変更なし

formulas: regime: causal rolling Gaussian HMM state s_t from monthly returns
NCO: cluster assets by correlation, optimize weights within each cluster, then across clusters
turnover_t = ½ Σ_i |w_i,t − w_i,t−1|
persistence guard idea: switch regime only if P(s_t = new) > threshold for k consecutive months
site use: watch only — no screener change while the math gate is not passed

items.title: The Reaction of Financial Markets to the Releases of DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K3: A Critical Analysis

titleLocalized.en: Why DeepSeek Hit Chip Stocks but Kimi K3 Did Not
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 為什麼 DeepSeek 重挫晶片股，Kimi K3 卻沒有？
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 为什么 DeepSeek 重挫芯片股，Kimi K3 却没有？
titleLocalized.ja: DeepSeekは半導体株を急落させ、Kimi K3はそうでなかった理由

items.summary: Compares how markets reacted to two Chinese AI model launches. DeepSeek R1 (January 2025) came with open weights and very low reported training and running costs, so investors questioned how much computing hardware the world would need, and chip and data-centre stocks fell hard. Kimi K3 (July 2026) launched at roughly frontier prices, so the hit landed mostly on rival Chinese AI labs instead. The author argues that cheap open models move profits around the AI supply chain rather than wiping them out, and that incumbents are protected by distribution, bundling, switching costs, data, serving capacity and trust. The evidence is descriptive event windows, not a tested trading rule. Takeaway for the site: when a new AI model launches, first ask whether it changes the cost of compute; only then is a sharp semiconductor sell-off the likely reaction.

summaryLocalized.en: Event-window comparison of DeepSeek R1 (Jan 2025: open weights, very low reported training/inference cost, large drops in semiconductor and data-centre stocks) and Kimi K3 (Jul 2026: frontier-level pricing, reaction concentrated in rival Chinese AI labs). Argues open-weight models redistribute rents along the AI value chain rather than eliminate them; incumbents keep complementary assets (distribution, bundling, switching costs, data, serving capacity, trust). Descriptive, no tested rule. Site use: watch — a checklist for reading AI-launch shocks to semis/SOXL.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 比較兩次中國 AI 模型發表後的股市反應。DeepSeek R1（2025 年 1 月）開放權重、宣稱訓練和使用成本極低，投資人開始懷疑全世界到底需要多少算力，晶片股和資料中心股大跌。Kimi K3（2026 年 7 月）定價跟頂尖模型差不多，所以受傷的主要是其他中國 AI 公司，而不是晶片股。作者認為便宜的開源模型是把 AI 產業鏈的利潤「搬家」，不是讓利潤消失；大公司靠通路、綁售、轉換成本、資料、伺服器產能和客戶信任守住地位。證據是事件前後的描述性比較，不是驗證過的交易規則。本站觀察：新 AI 模型發表時，先看它有沒有改變「算力成本」，有的話半導體才比較可能急跌。

items.title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders

titleLocalized.en: Do Skilled Institutional Day Traders Win by Forecasting or by Waiting in the Queue?
titleLocalized.zh-Hant: 法人當沖賺錢，靠預測還是靠掛單？
titleLocalized.zh-Hans: 机构日内交易赚钱，靠预测还是靠挂单？
titleLocalized.ja: 機関の日中売買の儲けは予測力か、指値で待つことか

items.summary: Uses detailed trade-by-trade data from one stock exchange to see what makes institutional traders' own intraday trading profitable. Some traders show forecasting skill that persists over time; simply copying their order flow on paper would have had extremely high risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe ratios of 16 to 63), but that needs exchange-level data nobody outside has in real time. Matching each buy to its sell, better forecasting goes with more profit per trade, and so does using resting limit orders: trades where both legs waited in the order book earned clearly more than trades where both legs crossed the spread. Takeaway for the site: for retail-sized orders, patient limit orders beat paying the spread; the copy-the-pros returns are not reachable with public data.

summaryLocalized.en: High-frequency exchange data on institutional proprietary intraday trading. Forecasting skill is persistent; hypothetical flow-following strategies on skilled traders' executions reach annualized Sharpe 16–63 (needs non-public account-level data). Matched-position P&L rises 1.02–1.19 currency units per 1-SD forecasting skill; one passive leg adds 1.28–1.31 units vs none, two passive legs a further 3.79–3.82. Site use: watch — supports limit-order execution in the paper book; flow-following is not reproducible with public data.
summaryLocalized.zh-Hant: 用某交易所逐筆成交資料，研究法人自營部位的當日交易靠什麼賺錢。有些交易員的預測能力會持續；如果紙上照抄他們的下單方向，風險調整後報酬極高（夏普值 16 到 63），但這需要交易所才有的帳戶級即時資料，外人拿不到。把每筆買和賣配對後發現：預測越準，每筆賺越多；而且用「掛單等成交」比「直接吃市價」賺得多，兩邊都掛單的部位明顯最好。本站觀察：散戶規模下單，耐心掛限價單比付買賣價差划算；「跟著法人」的高報酬用公開資料做不到。
summaryLocalized.zh-Hans: 用某交易所逐笔成交数据，研究机构自营部位的当日交易靠什么赚钱。有些交易员的预测能力会持续；如果纸上照抄他们的下单方向，风险调整后报酬极高（夏普值 16 到 63），但这需要交易所才有的账户级实时数据，外人拿不到。把每笔买和卖配对后发现：预测越准，每笔赚越多；而且用“挂单等成交”比“直接吃市价”赚得多，两边都挂单的部位明显最好。本站观察：散户规模下单，耐心挂限价单比付买卖价差划算；“跟着机构”的高报酬用公开数据做不到。
summaryLocalized.ja: ある取引所の高頻度データで、機関の自己勘定日中取引の収益源を分析。一部トレーダーの予測力は持続的で、その注文フローに追随する仮想戦略はシャープ比16〜63（ただし非公開の口座単位データが必要）。売買を対応付けると、予測力が高いほど1件あたり利益が大きく、指値で待つ約定が多いほど利益も大きい（両側とも指値が最良）。本サイトはウォッチ：小口は指値で待つほうが有利、プロ追随の高収益は公開データでは再現不可。

本站觀察：模擬單維持限價思維，不新增「跟法人」規則
